CT_QuantumMoonObservation.en: ANNONA: Given its reluctance to move while consciously observed, it might be a form of macroscopic quantum mechanics.
CT_QuantumMoonObservation.zh:
安诺纳：在别人有意识地对这颗卫星观察的时候，它就不会移动。

有鉴于此，该现象可能是宏观量子力学的一种形式。

CT_QuantumMoonObservation_2.en: ANNONA: The Quantum Moon locator is functioning. We have markers for each of the places the moon goes.
CT_QuantumMoonObservation_2.zh:
安诺纳：量子卫星定位器工作正常。我们把所有卫星出现的位置

都打上了标记。

CT_QuantumMoonObservation_2.en: MELORAE: Annona, Bur, I just observed the Quantum Moon in orbit around Dark Bramble.
CT_QuantumMoonObservation_2.zh: 梅洛瑞：安诺纳，伯尔，我刚刚在黑棘星的轨道附近观察到了量子卫星。

CT_QuantumMoonObservation_2.en: ANNONA: You have keen eyes, my friend. So this moon travels to a total of five locations, not four.
CT_QuantumMoonObservation_2.zh:
安诺纳：你的眼神可真好，我的朋友。这么说卫星一共会出现在

五个位置，而不是四个。

CT_QuantumMoonObservation_2.en: BUR: I added a marker for Dark Bramble.
CT_QuantumMoonObservation_2.zh: 伯尔：我把黑棘星的标记添加了上去。

CT_QuantumMoonObservation_2.en: BUR: I thought the locator now accounted for all of the phantom moon’s locations, but sometimes the locator can’t tell where the moon is. Perhaps there’s a problem with the device?
CT_QuantumMoonObservation_2.zh:
伯尔：我想定位器现在掌握了幻影卫星的所有位置，不过有时

定位器无法探测出卫星到底在哪儿。是不是设备出了问题？

CT_QuantumMoonObservation_2.en: MELORAE: It’s also possible there exists a sixth place in this star system to which the phantom moon travels.
CT_QuantumMoonObservation_2.zh:
梅洛瑞：也有可能幻影卫星会出现在这个星系的第六个位置

上。

CT_Quantum_ColeusTrapped.en: COLEUS: How curious! This rock took me with it to a new location. I wonder why this happened?
CT_Quantum_ColeusTrapped.zh:
科利耶斯：真是奇怪！这块岩石把我带到了一个新的地方。

不知道为什么会这样？

CT_Quantum_ColeusTrapped.en: COLEUS: Curious, but also alarming: This new cave appears to lack an entrance or exit. Also, the rock that brought me here disappeared while I wasn’t watching.
CT_Quantum_ColeusTrapped.zh:
科利耶斯：奇怪，不过也叫人很害怕：这个新的山洞好像并没有出入口。

同时，把我带来的岩石在我移开视线的时候消失

了。

CT_Quantum_ColeusTrapped.en: COLEUS: The wandering rock has returned! Never before have I been so delighted to see a sedimentary specimen.
CT_Quantum_ColeusTrapped.zh:
科利耶斯：那块流浪岩石回来了！我以前从来没有像现在这

样，

看到一块沉积岩标本如此高兴。

CT_Quantum_ColeusTrapped.en: COLEUS: I wonder if I myself became quantum briefly when the rock carried me here! This seems the clearest explanation. Hypothesis: If the rock can bring me here, it can also carry me out.
CT_Quantum_ColeusTrapped.zh:
科利耶斯：不知道这块岩石把我带来的时候，我自己是不是也暂时

进入了量子态！这貌似是最合理的解释。假设：如果这块岩石能把

我带进来，那么它也可以把我带出去。

CT_Quantum_ColeusTrapped.en: COLEUS: My hypothesis was correct! I can travel on this rock, as long as I’m not observing my surroundings (meaning I must be in complete darkness). I’m going to bring my mentor here to see this.
CT_Quantum_ColeusTrapped.zh:
科利耶斯：我的假设是正确的！只要我不对自己的周围进行观察（也

就是说我必须完全处于黑暗之中），我就可以在这块岩石上移动。

我一定要把我的导师带来瞧一瞧。

CT_Quantum_ColeusTrapped.en: COLEUS: Melorae is here now, too. We theorize when a conscious being is in contact with a quantum object and ceases to act as an observer (explaining the need for darkness), the being can become entangled with that quantum object, and they move together.
CT_Quantum_ColeusTrapped.zh:
科利耶斯：现在梅洛瑞也来了。我们提出的理论是，假如一个有意识的

存在接触到一个量子对象，并且不再表现出观察者的行为（这也就解释了

黑暗环境的必要性），那么该存在就能和量子对象进入纠缠态，

从而一起移动。

CT_Quantum_ColeusTrapped.en: MELORAE: Friends, Coleus has discovered a new quantum rule! (He has also promised me he’ll never vanish again, even if he does learn something useful from it!)
CT_Quantum_ColeusTrapped.zh:
梅洛瑞：朋友们，科利耶斯发现了一条新的量子法则！（他还向我保证

自己再也不会消失了，就算能够从中学到有用的知识也不行！）

CT_Quantum_EntanglementHint.en: MELORAE: If you’ve come here to look for Coleus, this is where we were when he vanished. He’s been missing for two days now!
CT_Quantum_EntanglementHint.zh:
梅洛瑞：如果你是来找科利耶斯的，这里就是当时他消失的地方。

他已经失踪两天了！

CT_Quantum_EntanglementHint.en: ANNONA: Your strange, wandering rock friend is here, though Coleus isn’t.
CT_Quantum_EntanglementHint.zh: 安诺纳：你那块奇怪的流浪岩石朋友还在这里，但是科利耶斯却不见了。

CT_Quantum_EntanglementHint.en: MELORAE: Coleus and I observed this unusual-looking rock shard (and several smaller rocks) in at least two other caverns. I’m unsure if this is relevant.
CT_Quantum_EntanglementHint.zh:
梅洛瑞：科利耶斯和我在至少另外两个洞窟里，都观察到了这种模样

不同寻常的岩石碎片（还有一些较小的岩石）。我不知道这一切是否

有所关联。

CT_Quantum_EntanglementHint.en: BUR: What happened before Coleus disappeared?
CT_Quantum_EntanglementHint.zh: 伯尔：科利耶斯失踪之前发生了什么？

CT_Quantum_EntanglementHint.en: MELORAE: We were examining the different rocks. I recall Coleus standing on the largest one (the wandering rock). I was taking notes, and then my lantern died.
CT_Quantum_EntanglementHint.zh:
梅洛瑞：我们正在对不同的岩石进行检查。我记得科利耶斯当时站在最大

的一块岩石上面（流浪岩石）。我正在记笔记，然后我的灯就熄了。

CT_Quantum_EntanglementHint.en: MELORAE: When I lit it again, Coleus and the rock were both gone.
CT_Quantum_EntanglementHint.zh: 梅洛瑞：等我再次把灯点亮的时候，科利耶斯和那块岩石就都不见了。

CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_1a.en: MELORAE: This rock is very familiar! Did you travel here, my sedimentary friend? Because your unique color and texture appears identical to a rock I met earlier.
CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_1a.zh:
梅洛瑞：这块岩石真是眼熟！你是自己过来的吗？我的沉积岩朋友？

因为你的颜色和材质十分特别，和我之前遇到的一块岩石一模一样。

CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_1a.en: MELORAE: Wasn’t this same rock fragment in the cave we found at the bottom of the dry lakebed (at the north pole)?
CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_1a.zh:
梅洛瑞：它会不会就是我们在干湖床底部（北极）的那个洞穴里发现

的那块岩石碎片？

CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_1a.en: COLEUS: An update: Melorae and I went back to the Lakebed Cave and observed this rock again. Sometimes it’s there, and sometimes it isn’t.
CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_1a.zh:
科利耶斯：更新：梅洛瑞和我回到了湖床洞穴，

再次观察了这块岩石。有时它会出现在那里，有时却不会。

CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_1a.en: MELORAE: That means this rock wanders like the Quantum Moon does. How curious!
CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_1a.zh:
梅洛瑞：也就是说，这块岩石和量子卫星一样，

会到处移动。真是奇怪！

CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_1a.en: COLEUS: We plan to reexamine the northern Lakebed Cave. (Maybe our friendly rock will meet us down there!)
CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_1a.zh:
科利耶斯：我们打算重新检查一下北边的湖床洞穴。（也许我们的

岩石朋友在那里等着我们呢！）

CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_1b.en: MELORAE: Coleus is missing! He vanished from the Lakebed Cave (the one at the bottom of the dry lakebed at the north pole) several days ago, and we’re unable to find any trace of him. I don’t know how much air he had when he disappeared. I beg any friend reading this, help us recover Coleus!
CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_1b.zh:
梅洛瑞：科利耶斯不见了！几天前，他从湖床洞穴（北极干湖床底部

的那个洞穴）里消失了，我们完全找不到他的踪迹。我不知道他消失的

时候还有多少空气。我恳请听到这段消息的朋友们，

帮我们找找科利耶斯！

CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_2.en: MELORAE: Friends, if you find any sign of Coleus, I implore you to tell me! He vanished without a trace during our research trip, and has been missing ever since.
CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_2.zh:
梅洛瑞：朋友们，如果你们发现任何科利耶斯的踪迹，请一定要告诉我！

我们当时正在进行研究之旅，他就这样消失得无影无踪，

并且从此全无音信。

CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_2.en: BUR: Melorae, some of us from the Sunless City are here to help search for Coleus. Can you tell us more about your expedition?
CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_2.zh:
伯尔：梅洛瑞，我们有几个人从背阴城过来，要帮忙寻找科利耶斯。

你能再跟我们说说那次远征的事情吗？

CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_2.en: MELORAE: You have my gratitude, Bur! Coleus and I were studying the caves’ geology. We hoped to learn more about a unique and wandering rock that visits several different caves in the area.
CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_2.zh:
梅洛瑞：感激不尽，伯尔！科利耶斯和我正在研究这个山洞的地质情况。

有一块罕见的流浪岩石会出现在这一地区的不同洞穴里，

我们希望多了解一下它。

CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_2.en: ANNONA: Where was young Coleus lost, Melorae?
CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_2.zh: 安诺纳：小科利耶斯是在哪儿不见的，梅洛瑞？

CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_2.en: MELORAE: He disappeared in the cave at the bottom of the dry lakebed at the north pole. It happened in an instant, and without warning.
CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_2.zh:
梅洛瑞：他是在北极干湖床底部的那个洞穴里消失的。

事情发生得很突然，一点征兆都没有。

CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_2.en: MELORAE: I turned away from Coleus to examine a sample, and when I turned back, he simply wasn’t there anymore. He had a limited supply of air, Annona! I’m afraid for him!
CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_2.zh:
梅洛瑞：当时我转身去检查一个样本，等回过头来的时候，科利耶斯

就已经不在那儿了。他的空气补给有限，安诺纳！我很担心他！

CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_2.en: ANNONA: Hypothesis: We will learn more by examining the northern Lakebed Cave where Coleus disappeared. Search quickly, everyone; we have no time to squander!
CT_Quantum_WanderingRock_2.zh:
安诺纳：假设：我们要对科利耶斯当时消失的北部湖床洞穴

进行检查，这样就能进一步了解情况。大家行动要快；

我们没有时间可以挥霍！

CT_SunStationDebate.en: Should we build the Sun Station to power the Ash Twin Project?
CT_SunStationDebate.zh: 我们要不要建造太阳站来为灰烬双星计划提供动力？

CT_SunStationDebate.en: IDAEA: I almost can’t comprehend this is being suggested seriously. The purpose of the Sun Station goes against every standard we hold ourselves to and everything we believe in as a species!
CT_SunStationDebate.zh:
伊代亚：我几乎难以理解怎么会有人真的提出这种建议。这个太阳站

的功能与我们自身的道德标准以及我们作为一个物种的信仰是

背道而驰的！

CT_SunStationDebate.en: PYE: Unsurprisingly, Idaea, I disagree. We’re pushing a possible new technology further than ever before. That, in my experience, is the defining characteristic of our species.
CT_SunStationDebate.zh:
派伊：毫不奇怪，伊代亚，我不同意你的看法。我们正在推动一项史无

前例的潜在新技术。以我的经验来说，此举正是我们这一物种的特色。

CT_SunStationDebate.en: YARROW: Are there other ways to generate this level of power?
CT_SunStationDebate.zh: 亚罗：有没有其它办法可以产生这种水平的动力？

CT_SunStationDebate.en: PYE: Theoretically, yes. Practically, no. I can’t imagine discovering them in our lifetimes...
CT_SunStationDebate.zh:
派伊：理论上是有的。实际上，并不可行。我很难想象我们这辈子

能够找到那样的方法……

CT_SunStationDebate.en: RAMIE: I understand this proposal is unsettling, but the Sun Station must be built if we hope to complete the Ash Twin Project.
CT_SunStationDebate.zh:
瑞米：我明白这个建议叫人非常不安，但如果我们打算完成

灰烬双星计划，那就必须建造太阳站。

CT_SunStationDebate.en: COLEUS: If we fail (and the probability of this is not insignificant), we will without question destroy ourselves, all life here, and the rest of this star system. I wish to protect these species.
CT_SunStationDebate.zh:
科利耶斯：如果我们失败了（这种可能性并不小），毫无疑

问，我们

就会把自己，这里的所有生命，还有这个星系的一切全部摧毁。

我想要保护这些物种。

CT_SunStationDebate.en: IDAEA: The potential annihilation of an entire star system is too severe a cost. We shouldn’t build the Sun Station, no matter how badly we want the knowledge that comes with it.
CT_SunStationDebate.zh:
伊代亚：有可能毁灭整个星系，这个代价实在是太沉重了。无论我们多么

渴望了解其中的奥秘，我们都不该建造太阳站。

CT_SunStationDebate.en: POKE: Fear of failure is a poor reason not to try. I believe, if we’re cautious, the Sun Station will work. I believe in Pye.
CT_SunStationDebate.zh:
珀克：害怕失败并非拒绝尝试的借口。我相信，如果我们谨慎小心，

那么太阳站一定可以成功。我相信派伊。

CT_SunStationDebate.en: PYE: Poke, I’m deeply honored. Idaea, I comprehend your position; however, if we aren’t all but certain the Sun Station will not cause destruction once we’ve built it, then I won’t support the station’s use.
CT_SunStationDebate.zh:
派伊：珀克，我深表荣幸。伊代亚，我理解你的立场；然而，

假如我们无法确保建造太阳站之后不会导致毁灭性的结果，

那么我是不会支持使用太阳站的。

CT_TLE_CityToExperimentHint.en: RAMIE: Note: This door will need to remain closed for some time! Pye and I are running an experiment based on the extraordinary findings from the White Hole Station.
CT_TLE_CityToExperimentHint.zh:
瑞米：备注：这扇门一段时间内不会开启！基于在白洞站上

的异常发现，派伊和我正在进行一次实验。

CT_TLE_CityToExperimentHint.en: PYE: Ramie and I will be running this experiment until one of us (specifically, me) can prove the other wrong, so although it’s inconvenient, the lab currently can only be accessed by the path from the Sunless City.
CT_TLE_CityToExperimentHint.zh:
派伊：瑞米和我会把实验继续下去，直到我们其中一个人（特别是

我）可以证明对方的假设是错的。因此尽管很不方便，但是目前

实验室只能从背阴城的通路进入。

CT_TLE_CityToExperimentHint.en: RAMIE: Inviting sand inside would disrupt our setup and could have enormous consequences. (We realize this is an intriguing prospect, but the door must remain closed nonetheless!)
CT_TLE_CityToExperimentHint.zh:
瑞米：让沙子进来会干扰我们的实验设置，并可能造成严重的后果。（我

们明白这种情形一定会十分有意思，不过无论如

何，

这道门都必须紧紧关上！）

CT_TLE_CityToExperimentHint.en: RAMIE: An update: The High Energy Lab is now being used to design the Ash Twin Project! If you’re here to help (or even just to observe), be sure to use the Sunless City path to the lab.
CT_TLE_CityToExperimentHint.zh:
瑞米：更新：高能实验室目前正在用来设计灰烬双星计划！如果

你想要来帮忙（或者只是旁观），务必使用背阴城的通路前往实验室。

CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements1.en: RAMIE: The Southern Observatory is asking if creating a 22 minute interval is possible (that is, to have something arrive 22 minutes before it is actually sent through the warp).
CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements1.zh:
瑞米：南部天文台询问制造一个22分钟的间隔是否有可能（也

就是说，让某个对象在完成跃迁22分钟之前就抵达目的地）。

CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements1.en: RAMIE: We’ve learned the negative interval of time between departure and arrival can be increased by adding more energy to the warp core. Problematically, the energy required to extend the interval increases at an exponential rate.
CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements1.zh:
瑞米：我们已经得知，增加更多跃迁核心的能量，就可以加强出发与抵达

之间的时间倒流间隔。问题在于，增加间隔所需的能量是呈指数增长的。

CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements1.en: PYE: Hypothesis: Creating a 22-minute-long interval is possible, but we are currently unable to generate the necessary energy.
CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements1.zh:
派伊：假设：制造一个22分钟的间隔是可行的，但我们目前无法生成必要

的能量。

CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements1.en: PYE: Ramie and I believe it would be necessary to invent a new method of producing energy, a thrilling but enormous undertaking. We would also require advanced warp technology able to handle such energy.
CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements1.zh:
派伊：瑞米和我相信有必要发明一种新的方法来产生能量，这是一项

激动人心同时又十分艰巨的工作。我们还需要能够承受住这种能量的

高级跃迁技术。

CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements1.en: PYE: We would also likely need an enormous space to fit these proposed new energy and warp technologies together. The only location large enough would be Ash Twin.
CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements1.zh:
派伊：我们还要寻找一个广阔的空间来容纳上述的新型能量以及

跃迁技术。唯一满足条件的地方就是灰烬双星。

CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements1.en: RAMIE: The energy is currently unavailable, you say? You’re a gas, Pye!
CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements1.zh: 瑞米：你是说，能量目前无法生成？你真是有意思，派伊！

CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements1.en: PYE: My pun was unintended, Ramie, so I believe it’s you who’s aeriform!
CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements1.zh: 派伊：我没有开玩笑，瑞米，我说的是实话！

CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements2.en: PYE: The Ash Twin Project will be one of our biggest undertakings (metaphorically and physically). To build it, we need a way to travel quickly between Ash Twin and each location that holds crucial project materials.
CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements2.zh: 派伊：灰烬双星计划将会是我们规模最大的计划之一（不管是修辞上的说法还是实际上的）。为了进行建造，我们需要想出一个办法，在灰烬双星和所有存放计划所需关键物资的地点之间进行快速移动。

CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements2.en: ROOT: What if we used warp towers (like the one we have on the White Hole Station) to connect Ash Twin directly to each critical location?
CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements2.zh: 鲁特：我们用跃迁塔（就像白洞站上的那座一样）把灰烬双星和所有关键位置直接连在一起，怎么样？

CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements2.en: CLARY: Poke, Root, and I can begin work on this immediately in the Black Hole Forge (this will keep us busy!).
CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements2.zh: 克莱瑞：珀克、鲁特还有我可以立刻在黑洞熔炉展开这项工作（这样我们就有事干了！）。

CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements2.en: YARROW: Of note: Each tower on Ash Twin will warp to a different planet.
CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements2.zh:
亚罗：注意事项：灰烬双星上的每座高塔都将通往不同的行

星。

CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements2.en: PHLOX: We can design each tower to visually reflect its warp destination!
CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements2.zh: 弗拉克斯：我们可以把每座高塔的外观都设计成对应跃迁目的地的风格！

CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements2.en: PHLOX: The Giant’s Deep tower, for instance, could resemble a cyclone. And we could model the Timber Hearth tower after a geyser mountain!
CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements2.zh: 弗拉克斯：比如说，深巨星塔的外观可以是一团气旋。而木炉星塔可以设计成像间歇泉山那样！

CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements2.en: YARROW: My gratitude to those who noted my imprecise language! Yes, the sun is not a planet. I believe this has been sufficiently clarified (kindly stop reminding me!).
CT_TLE_TimeLoopEnergyRequirements2.zh:
亚罗：谢谢大家提醒我用词不准！是的，太阳并不是一颗行

星。我想这样就足够明确了（请不要再提醒我了！）。

CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed1.en: PYE: Records show Nomai arriving at the warp receiver on Brittle Hollow very slightly before departing from the White Hole Station. Ramie and I are devising an experiment to test if this is a real phenomenon or simple machine error.
CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed1.zh:
派伊：记录显示，挪麦人抵达碎空星跃迁接收点的时间比离开

白洞站的时间要稍微早那么一点点。瑞米和我正在设计实验，

看看这是一种正常现象，还是机器出了故障。

CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed1.en: RAMIE: In theory, what we want to try to reproduce is a negative amount of time elapsing between something entering the black hole and exiting the white hole at its destination.
CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed1.zh:
瑞米：理论上，我们想要重现的是某个对象进入黑洞以及离开白洞抵达

目的地之间所产生的时间倒流。

CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed1.en: PYE: Initial things first: Our experiment setup will first pair a small black hole core with a small white hole core to mimic the setup on the White Hole Station.
CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed1.zh:
派伊：当务之急：我们的实验首先会匹配一对小型黑洞核心和白洞核心，

来模拟白洞站上的设置。

CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed1.en: RAMIE: Hypothesis: It is possible for an object to exit a white hole before entering the corresponding black hole.
CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed1.zh: 瑞米：假设：对象在进入相应的黑洞之前 就从 白洞离开是有可能的。

CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed2.en: RAMIE: An update: Our experiment here reproduced the anomaly in arrival and departure times, but Pye is unconvinced it’s more than an equipment error. I hope to strengthen the effect to render it visible to the unaided eyes.
CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed2.zh:
瑞米：更新：我们的实验再现了出发与抵达的时间异常，然而派伊依然

坚持问题的原因是设备故障。我希望能够加强实验效果，让肉眼也能

观察到。

CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed2.en: PYE: To that end, we’ve decided to try adding more energy. I imagine the Sunless City’s energy supply should prove sufficient.
CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed2.zh:
派伊：为此，我们决定增加更多的能量。我想背阴城的能量供给应该

可以满足要求。

CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed2.en: PYE: Of note, Ramie: Yarrow requests that we let him know before we reroute energy to the experiment.
CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed2.zh: 派伊：注意事项，瑞米：亚罗要求我们在为实验转移能量之前通知他。

CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed2.en: RAMIE: I’d hate to leave him in the dark!
CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed2.zh: 瑞米：我可不愿意把他蒙在鼓里！

CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed2.en: PYE: All available energy has been rerouted from the city to our experiment. Ramie and I are about to run a new test.
CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed2.zh:
派伊：城市里所有可用的能量都转移到了我们的实验上。瑞米和我即将

进行一次新的测试。

CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed2.en: RAMIE: Hypothesis confirmed! Hypothesis confirmed! I saw it! Pye saw it! Hypothesis confirmed!
CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed2.zh:
瑞米：假设得到了确认！假设得到了确认！我看见了！派伊也看见了！

假设得到了确认！

CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed2.en: PYE: This is beyond extraordinary! This changes everything! What a beautiful day for the intersection of abstract theory and practical application!
CT_TLE_TimeTravelConfirmed2.zh:
派伊：实在是非同凡响！它改变了一切！抽象理论和实际应用

相结合，多么美妙的一天！

C_Interior_ChooseCarefullyRecording.en: PYE: I’m receiving much stronger energy readings now that we’re beneath the crust. Whatever it is must lie somewhere below, closer to the comet’s center. And I’m starting to think it’s more dangerous than we realized.
C_Interior_ChooseCarefullyRecording.zh:
派伊：我们已经进入了彗星外壳，能量读数比以前更加强烈

了。

源头一定就在下面靠近彗星中心的地方。我开始觉得它比我们

预想得还要危险。

C_Interior_ChooseCarefullyRecording.en: PYE: Clary, can you hear us?
C_Interior_ChooseCarefullyRecording.zh: 派伊：克莱瑞，你能听见吗？

C_Interior_ChooseCarefullyRecording.en: CLARY: Yes, but your voices are faint. I fear we will lose communication entirely if you continue any deeper.
C_Interior_ChooseCarefullyRecording.zh:
克莱瑞：可以，不过你的声音很微弱。恐怕你们继续深入的

话，

我们就会彻底失去联系。

C_Interior_ChooseCarefullyRecording.en: POKE: Keep the shuttle warm for us, Clary. We’ll return the moment we identify the source of the energy readings!
C_Interior_ChooseCarefullyRecording.zh:
珀克：克莱瑞，替我们保持航天飞机的温度。一旦识别出能量读数的

来源，我们就马上回来！

C_Interior_ChooseCarefullyRecording.en: CLARY: I understand, but... Be cautious, both of you.
C_Interior_ChooseCarefullyRecording.zh: 克莱瑞：我明白，可是……你们两个，都要小心。

C_Interior_FinalRecording.en: POKE: The spherical stone casing here seems to be the source of the energy readings... No, rather, the source is what’s within the stone. I’m detecting some form of exotic matter.
C_Interior_FinalRecording.zh:
珀克：看起来这个球形的岩石壳体就是能量读数的源头……不对，能量是

从岩石里面辐射出来的。我检测到了某种奇异的物质形态。

C_Interior_FinalRecording.en: PYE: The stone is muting our energy readings; they should be ten times what we’re seeing, at least.
C_Interior_FinalRecording.zh:
派伊：这块岩石正在抑制我们的能量读数。正常的数据至少应该

是我们看到的十倍。

C_Interior_FinalRecording.en: POKE: Pye, I don’t think we want this matter interacting with us. As far as I can tell, direct contact with it would almost certainly be fatal.
C_Interior_FinalRecording.zh:
珀克：派伊，我觉得我们不能被这种物质接触到。就我所知，

直接暴露在它之下几乎肯定会致命。

C_Interior_FinalRecording.en: PYE: I’ve never encountered anything like this casing, but it’s all that’s protecting us from what’s inside. Worse still, this matter is disturbingly volatile.
C_Interior_FinalRecording.zh:
派伊：我以前从没见过这样的壳体。不过多亏了它，我们才不会被里面的

物质给害死。更要命的是，这种东西极度易挥发。

C_Interior_FinalRecording.en: POKE: ...Pye. Whatever the matter inside this stone casing is, it’s more than just profoundly unstable; it’s under tonnes of pressure. Look at this density scan. I’ve never seen anything this tightly compacted before! What is this?
C_Interior_FinalRecording.zh:
珀克：……派伊。包裹在这个岩石壳体里的物质不光是异常不稳定；

它还承受着数以吨计的压力。看看这份密度扫描的结

果。我从没见过

结构如此紧密的物质！它到底是什么东西？

C_Interior_FinalRecording.en: PYE: This is orders of magnitude worse than I’d imagined. If this stone were to rupture, the lethal matter within would rapidly expand, completely blanketing this star system almost instantaneously. And the pressure is still building as the comet approaches this star system...
C_Interior_FinalRecording.zh:
派伊：这比我预想得还要严重几个数量级。如果这块岩石裂开来，

那么里面的致命物质便会迅速传播，几乎一眨眼就可以覆盖整个星系。

而且，随着彗星不断接近这个星系，压力还在不断上升……

C_Interior_FinalRecording.en: PYE: Return to the shuttle, right now! The rest of our friends need to know they’re in terrible danger. Leave your equipment and run!
C_Interior_FinalRecording.zh:
派伊：回到航天飞机上去，马上！得让我们其他的朋友们知

道，

他们的处境极度危险。别管你的设备了，赶快跑！

C_Interior_FinalRecording.en: POKE: What are you doing, Pye?!
PYE: The more we know about this alien matter, the better our chances of survival. I will learn what I can here. Go, warn the others; maybe they can construct shelter somehow. ...Now, Poke!
C_Interior_FinalRecording.zh:
派伊：我们对这种外星物质了解得越多，活下来的机会就越

大。

我来尽力把它弄明白。快走，快去警告其他人，

没准他们还来得及把庇护所搭起来。……快啊，珀克！

C_Shuttle_InsideRecording.en: CLARY: I fear our situation may be dire:
C_Shuttle_InsideRecording.zh: 克莱瑞：恐怕我们的处境十分险峻：

C_Shuttle_InsideRecording.en: CLARY: Pye, Poke, and I landed here on this comet not long after its arrival in this star system. Our shuttle’s equipment heard strange energy readings coming from somewhere beneath the surface.
C_Shuttle_InsideRecording.zh:
克莱瑞：就在这颗彗星抵达该星系后不久，珀克、派伊和我降落在了

它的上面。我们的航天飞机上的设备发现，从彗星表面下传来了

奇怪的能量读数。

C_Shuttle_InsideRecording.en: CLARY: Pye and Poke were able to locate a fissure in the ice on the comet’s sunward side, and they descended inside to investigate the source of the readings.
C_Shuttle_InsideRecording.zh:
克莱瑞：珀克和派伊在彗星向阳面的冰面上找到了一处沟壑。

他们爬了下去，打算调查一下读数的来源。

C_Shuttle_InsideRecording.en: CLARY: But... Pye and my sister have been gone for a long time now. They haven’t contacted me since descending below the surface, either.
C_Shuttle_InsideRecording.zh:
克莱瑞：可是……自从进入地下之后，派伊和我的妹妹一直都没有回来。

他们也没有和我进行联系。

C_Shuttle_InsideRecording.en: CLARY: Should I leave the shuttle to look for them? I want to follow protocol, but I don’t know what I’ll do if they aren’t well...
C_Shuttle_InsideRecording.zh:
克莱瑞：我要不要丢下航天飞机去找他们？我也想遵守规定。

但万一他们出了什么事，我真不知道该怎么办才好……

C_Shuttle_InsideRecording.en: CLARY: Poke... Pye... Come back to me safely, my friends.
C_Shuttle_InsideRecording.zh: 克莱瑞：珀克……派伊……朋友们，你们一定要安全地回到我这里来。

C_Shuttle_OutsideRecording.en: CLARY: This is troublesome: It seems the comet wishes to submerge our shuttle in ice. If we stay on the surface too long, the shuttle may freeze entirely.
C_Shuttle_OutsideRecording.zh:
克莱瑞：这下麻烦了：看起来彗星会把我们的航天飞机给冻在冰块里。

如果我们在彗星表面上待得太久，航天飞机可能会被彻底冻住。

C_Shuttle_OutsideRecording.en: POKE: Even if it did, couldn’t someone call it back home to the gravity cannon on Ember Twin?
C_Shuttle_OutsideRecording.zh: 珀克：就算是这样，余烬双星上的人也可以把它召回到重力炮那里去啊？

C_Shuttle_OutsideRecording.en: PYE: Yes, but the exploration of the comet would be more difficult if we were without the shuttle until someone recalled it. Perhaps we shouldn’t have landed on the dark side of the comet...
C_Shuttle_OutsideRecording.zh:
派伊：没错，但是在有人召回之前，少了航天飞机，我们对彗星

的探索将会变得更加艰难。也许我们就不该降落在彗星的阴暗面……

C_Shuttle_OutsideRecording.en: CLARY: Suppose one of us remained in the shuttle to keep it warm and continue monitoring the surface.
C_Shuttle_OutsideRecording.zh:
克莱瑞：估计我们之中的一个得留在航天飞机里，保持它的温度，

并不断监控彗星表面。

C_Shuttle_OutsideRecording.en: PYE: This would be wise, I think, Clary. If you don’t mind waiting here with it, Poke and I can continue to investigate the surface.
C_Shuttle_OutsideRecording.zh:
派伊：我想这个办法很明智，克莱瑞。如果你不介意在这里等我们的话，

珀克和我可以继续对彗星表面进行调查。

DB_EscapePod_BrambleSeedRecording.en: SECCA: To any who come here searching for us: We followed one of the two beacons from the Vessel to this place, but now can go no further.
DB_EscapePod_BrambleSeedRecording.zh:
塞卡：给来找我们的人：我们跟着飞船发出的两个信标之一

来到了这个地方，但现在我们没法继续前进了。

DB_EscapePod_BrambleSeedRecording.en: SECCA: It's almost too faint to hear now, but the Vessel’s beacon is still faintly emitting from within this thorny seed. Yet the opening is too small for even a single Nomai to fit through it, so our escape pod couldn’t have flown through here.
DB_EscapePod_BrambleSeedRecording.zh:
塞卡：信号现在已经快接收不到了，但是飞船的信标还在从这个带刺

的种子里向外进行微弱的发射。开口太小，就连一个挪麦人都钻不过去，

所以我们的逃生舱没办法飞进去。

DB_EscapePod_BrambleSeedRecording.en: SECCA: I don’t understand how this could be possible, but this gruesome place seems able to manipulate space itself; maybe this was our undoing.
DB_EscapePod_BrambleSeedRecording.zh:
塞卡：我不明白这怎么可能，不过这个可怕的地方貌似能够操控空间；

也许这就是我们末日。

DB_EscapePod_BrambleSeedRecording.en: SECCA: To be so close to the location of the Vessel and still so far is... difficult. Worse, the Vessel’s beacon is dying; soon, we will be unable to hear it.
DB_EscapePod_BrambleSeedRecording.zh:
塞卡：飞船的位置就在眼前，可要找到它却……如此困难。

更糟糕的是，飞船的信标正在衰减；很快我们就要接收不到信号了。

DB_EscapePod_BrambleSeedRecording.en: SECCA: There is nothing we can do now but try to perhaps find a way inside, or at least attempt to comprehend why this happened.
DB_EscapePod_BrambleSeedRecording.zh:
塞卡：现在我们什么都做不了，只能试着看看能不能想办法进去，

或者至少弄清楚为什么会发生这样的事情。

DB_EscapePod_BrambleSeedRecording.en: SECCA: My dearest hope is that the other escape pods were able to reach relative safety.
DB_EscapePod_BrambleSeedRecording.zh: 塞卡：我最大的愿望就是其它逃生舱落到了相对安全的地方。

DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_1.en: SECCA: Our escape pod crashed as we tried to flee this place, destroying our movement and communication capabilities in the process.
DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_1.zh:
塞卡：我们想要逃离这个地方，结果逃生舱坠毁了，我们丧失了

移动和通讯能力。

DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_1.en: SECCA: We’ve held out as long as we could here, but this pod’s supply of breathable air is nearly depleted, and the anglerfish attack more and more frequently.
DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_1.zh:
塞卡：我们会在这里尽量坚持下去，不过逃生舱的空气补给即将耗尽，

安康鱼的进攻也变得越来越频繁。

DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_1.en: SECCA: Our best chance at survival is to return to the Vessel to either repair the damage or, more probably, await rescue.
DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_1.zh:
塞卡：只有回到飞船那里，把它修好；或者更有可能是在那里等待

救援，这样我们活下来的希望才最大。

DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_1.en: ESCALL: Secca, is the message finished? The Vessel’s beacon is already growing fainter; it will be gone in a matter of hours. We need to leave here, quickly.
DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_1.zh:
艾斯科尔：塞卡，消息结束了吗？飞船的信标已经开始减弱

了，

不出几个小时它就会消失。我们得尽快离开这里。

DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_2.en: DIN: There is a new problem: Our equipment is detecting two distinct beacons from the Vessel.
DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_2.zh:
迪恩：有一个新的问题：我们的设备在两个不同的地方检测到了

飞船发出的信标。

DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_2.en: SECCA: But it isn’t possible for the Vessel to be in two different locations at the same time.
DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_2.zh: 塞卡：可是飞船不可能同时出现在两个地方啊。

DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_2.en: DIN: I agree, but the beacons are exactly identical to each other. Perhaps if I had more time —
DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_2.zh:
迪恩：我同意，但这两个信标是完全相同的。

也许再给我一点时间的话……

DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_2.en: SECCA: We’re nearly out of time already, Din; the Vessel’s beacon is quickly fading. Soon, it will be gone, and we will be lost.
DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_2.zh:
塞卡：我们已经快没时间了，迪恩；飞船的信标正在迅速衰

减。

很快它就会消失，到时候我们就找不到路了。

DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_2.en: ESCALL: We will follow the beacon whose source is nearest to us.
DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_2.zh: 艾斯科尔：我们要跟着信标源最近的那个信标走。

DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_2.en: DIN: But suppose that beacon is false!
DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_2.zh: 迪恩：但万一那个信标是假的呢！

DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_2.en: ESCALL: We likely don’t have enough air to reach the farther of the two beacons, Din. The decision is made for us.
DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_2.zh:
艾斯科尔：我们不大可能有足够的空气去寻找

比较远的那个信标，迪恩。我们别无选择。

DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_2.en: ESCALL: We’ll leave a trail of lights as we go. There’s still a chance someone could hear our escape pod’s distress signal.
DB_EscapePod_CrashSiteRecording_2.zh:
艾斯科尔：我们一边走一边在路上留下发光路标。

别人依然有可能会收到我们的逃生舱发出来的信号。

DB_EscapePod_FlightLog.en: BEGIN FLIGHTLOG: Escape Pod 3. Vessel has been mortally injured. Emergency sequence activated. Awaiting departure from Vessel.
DB_EscapePod_FlightLog.zh:
飞行日志开始：3号逃生舱。飞船遭受严重损伤。

启动紧急程

序。正在等待从飞船撤离。

DB_EscapePod_FlightLog.en: ALERT: Multiple collisions have altered pod’s trajectory. Significant damage to pod detected.
DB_EscapePod_FlightLog.zh: 警报：多次碰撞改变了逃生舱的轨道。检测到逃生舱出现严重损伤。

DB_EscapePod_FlightLog.en: WARNING: Navigation error. Life support error. Propulsion error.
DB_EscapePod_FlightLog.zh: 警告：导航系统错误。维生系统错误。推进系统错误。

DB_EscapePod_FlightLog.en: Scanning external environment... Scan complete. Gravity not detected. Breathable air not detected. Multiple lifeforms detected (potentially hostile). Verdict: DO NOT EXIT POD.
DB_EscapePod_FlightLog.zh:
正在扫描外部环境……扫描完成。没有检测到重力。没有检测到可供呼吸

的空气。检测到多个生命形式（具有敌对可能

性）。

结论：不要走出逃生舱。

DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.en: CANNA: To any Nomai clans whose Vessels can hear this message:
DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.zh: 卡纳：所有能够收到这个消息的挪麦家族飞船注意：

DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.en: CANNA: It’s clear the universe is dying. There are fewer and fewer resources and safe places within space now, so my clan and I believe the best option is for all of our clans to stay together.
DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.zh:
卡纳：很明显，这个宇宙正在死亡。太空里安全的地方越来越少，

资源也是一样。因此我的家族和我认为，最好的办法就是让所有的

家族都团结在一起。

DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.en: CANNA: If you can reach the Gloaming Galaxy, we’ve found that Blackrock’s suns are fairly stable, and life in this star system is (comparatively) thriving. We live in relative safety.
DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.zh:
卡纳：如果你能够前往暮色银河那就最好，我们已经发现黑石星系的太阳

比较稳定，这个星系的生命比较起来还算是繁荣。在这里生活，我们可以

稍微安全一些。

DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.en: CANNA: If you prefer to continue exploring alone, know you will be on your own.
DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.zh: 卡纳：但是如果你想继续独自探索，那么你就只能靠自己了。

DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.en: BROMI: Canna, we’re making our way to you.
DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.zh: 布洛密：卡纳，我们正在朝你那里进发。

DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.en: CANNA: It’s good to hear from you, Bromi! We’ll watch for your Vessel.
DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.zh: 卡纳：很高兴收到你的消息，布洛密！我们会留意你的飞船。

DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.en: CANNA: Has anyone heard from Neem? His clan was on its way to our Vessel, but they never arrived, and he hasn’t sent any messages. I’m beginning to worry.
DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.zh:
卡纳：有尼姆的消息？他的家族正在朝我们的飞船前进，但一直没能

抵达。而且他也没有发来任何消息。我开始有点担心

了。

DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.en: BROMI: That is unsettling. It reminds me of that old myth my grandfather used to tell, the Disappearance of Escall.
DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.zh:
布洛密：那可真是不妙啊。我想起了祖父以前常常挂在嘴边的一个

古老传说：艾斯科尔的失踪。

DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.en: CLEM: I remember hearing that story as a child! One day, Escall’s Vessel simply stopped responding. The other clans searched and searched, but found no trace. It was as if their missing friends had warped out of existence.
DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.zh:
克莱姆：我记得小时候听过这个故事！有一天，艾斯科尔的飞船突然

没了消息。其他家族找了又找，可是一无所获。仿佛他们的朋友们

就这样彻底消失不见了。

DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.en: HYSSOP: That’s no myth, friends; Escall’s clan existed, and their story was real.
DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.zh:
希索普：那可不是什么传说，朋友们。艾斯科尔家族曾经存在过，

他们的故事也是真的。

DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.en: BROMI: What a curious event to have passed into myth! Our ancestors’ ancestors were told that story when they were young. Are you sure it’s true, Hyssop?
DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.zh:
布洛密：这样一个离奇的事件，怎么就成了传说呢！那是我们祖先的祖先

在小时候听长辈说的故事。你确定这个事情是真的吗，希索普？

DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.en: HYSSOP: It was a very long time ago, but yes. My clan’s ancestors searched for Escall’s clan for a long time, but in the end, none of them were ever seen again. (It’s the only time in our history a Vessel has ever disappeared this way.)
DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.zh:
希索普：事情已经过去很久了。不过它的确是真的。我们家族的祖先花了

很长时间来寻找艾斯科尔家族。但是到了最后，谁都没有再听说过他们的

消息。（飞船以这种方式失踪，在我们的历史上这是唯一的一次。）

DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.en: NEEM: Hyssop, I hope you aren’t comparing Escall’s story to my clan’s Vessel!
DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.zh:
尼姆：希索普，但愿你不是在拿艾斯科尔的故事和我们家族的

飞船打比方！

DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.en: CLEM: Neem, my friend! We feared you were gone!
DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.zh: 克莱姆：尼姆，我的朋友！我们还担心你是不是失踪了呢！

DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.en: NEEM: Not yet, we aren’t, but nearly. We found trouble during our warp: The triple suns of the Bright Spark star system exploded, and it was only a lucky coincidence we weren’t caught in the blast. We’ll meet you soon, Canna!
DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.zh:
尼姆：这倒是没有，不过就差一点。我们在跃迁的时候遇到了麻烦：闪耀

火花星系的三颗太阳爆发了。算我们走运，这才没被卷进去。

我们待会儿见，卡纳！

DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.en: CANNA: I’m relieved your clan is safe, Neem! It’s good to hear your words. Any Vessels nearby, remember to be extremely cautious of potentially unstable stars (which is most of them, now).
DB_Vessel_IncomingMessages.zh:
卡纳：你的家族没事可真是太好了，尼姆！很高兴能够收到你的消息。

附近所有的飞船，请多加小心可能出现的不稳定恒

星。就目前而言，

大部分恒星都不稳定。

DB_Vessel_OutgoingMessages.en: FILIX: This is Escall’s Vessel; something went badly wrong during our warp, and our Vessel is mortally wounded. We need help as quickly as possible!
DB_Vessel_OutgoingMessages.zh:
费利克斯：这里是艾斯科尔的飞船；我们的跃迁出了大问题，

我们的飞船遭受严重损伤。我们需要尽快得到帮助！

DB_Vessel_OutgoingMessages.en: FILIX: Our Vessel appears to have... has it fused with the local environment, somehow? There are vines that are now part of the Vessel! It’s been torn apart from inside itself!
DB_Vessel_OutgoingMessages.zh:
费利克斯：我们的飞船好像……好像和当地环境融合在了一起？

如今藤蔓也变成了飞船的一部分！它在内部拆卸自己！

DB_Vessel_OutgoingMessages.en: FILIX: We... we are abandoning our Vessel. Any Nomai clans or spaceflight-capable species receiving this message, I implore you, we need your help!
DB_Vessel_OutgoingMessages.zh:
费利克斯：我们……我们要放弃飞船了。收到这个消息的挪麦家族，

或是具有太空航行能力的种族，我恳请你们，我们需要你们的帮助！

DB_Vessel_OutgoingMessages.en: FILIX: Is this broken? Can anyone hear me? Our Vessel is dying! We need immediate assistance!
DB_Vessel_OutgoingMessages.zh:
费利克斯：这东西坏了吗？有人能听见吗？我们的飞船正在死亡！

我们急需援助！

DB_Vessel_SignalFirstContact.en: FILIX: I’m recording now — I’ve never encountered anything like this! The signal the Vessel is receiving appears to be older than the universe itself!
DB_Vessel_SignalFirstContact.zh:
费利克斯：我正在做记录，我从没见过这样的事情！飞船

收到的信号貌似比宇宙本身还要古老！

DB_Vessel_SignalFirstContact.en: ESCALL: This is our first contact with anything of this nature. Everyone, prepare to warp immediately!
DB_Vessel_SignalFirstContact.zh: 艾斯科尔：这是我们第一次接触到这种情况。所有人，准备立刻跃迁！

DB_Vessel_SignalFirstContact.en: FILIX: Escall, wait, I need more time to send an outgoing message! Shouldn’t we tell another clan where we’re going?
DB_Vessel_SignalFirstContact.zh:
费利克斯：艾斯科尔，等等，我需要一点时间来向外发送消

息！

难道我们不该把自己的目的地告诉其他家族吗？

DB_Vessel_SignalFirstContact.en: ESCALL: We can send the message upon our arrival. This extraordinary signal appeared suddenly; it may disappear just as quickly, and we can’t lose a discovery this incredible! Focus on preparing for the warp, instead.
DB_Vessel_SignalFirstContact.zh:
艾斯科尔：消息可以在我们抵达后再发。这个非同寻常的信号是突然

出现的；它可能也会瞬间消失，我们不能失去如此重大的发现！

还是集中精神为跃迁做好准备吧。

DB_Vessel_SignalFirstContact.en: ESCALL: Annona, is the Vessel ready to warp to the signal’s approximate coordinates?
DB_Vessel_SignalFirstContact.zh:
艾斯科尔：安诺纳，飞船准备好跃迁到信号的大致坐标上了

吗？

DB_Vessel_SignalFirstContact.en: ANNONA: The warp core is powered, but this will be a significant jump. Afterward, we’ll need time to recharge the core.
DB_Vessel_SignalFirstContact.zh:
安诺纳：跃迁核心充能完毕，但这次跃迁的距离十分遥远。我们之后需要

花时间为核心重新充能。

DB_Vessel_SignalFirstContact.en: ESCALL: That shouldn’t create a problem, provided we arrive at or near the signal’s source. Everyone, we’re ready to warp!
DB_Vessel_SignalFirstContact.zh:
艾斯科尔：只要我们能够抵达信号源的位置或是附近，

那就应该不成问题。所有人，我们准备跃迁！

GD_ConstructionYard_CannonMerge.en: CASSAVA: This is it: We’ve finished building the final Orbital Probe Cannon module and are ready to send it into orbit around Giant’s Deep for assembly!
GD_ConstructionYard_CannonMerge.zh:
卡萨瓦：行了：我们已经完成了轨道探测炮最终模块的建造，

并准备把它送入深巨星的轨道进行组装！

GD_ConstructionYard_CannonMerge.en: CASSAVA: To all my friends here at the Construction Yard, my gratitude for your tireless work. I had given up hope, but I truly believe this cannon may actually succeed where many other attempts have not.
GD_ConstructionYard_CannonMerge.zh:
卡萨瓦：所有建造厂的朋友们，我感激你们孜孜不倦的劳作。

我曾经失去了希望，但我真诚地相信这门大炮可以实现许多前人无法

实现的成就。

GD_ConstructionYard_CannonMerge.en: DAZ: Are you going gelatinous on us, love? I’m delighted by your words, but they’re atypical for you!
GD_ConstructionYard_CannonMerge.zh:
戴兹：你在跟我们套近乎吗，亲爱的？你的话让我很高兴，

但那也太不像你了！

GD_ConstructionYard_CannonMerge.en: CASSAVA: If I’m ever half as gooey as Mallow and Avens behave together, Daz, you may launch me from the Orbital Probe Cannon.
GD_ConstructionYard_CannonMerge.zh:
卡萨瓦：要是我有玛罗和埃文斯加起来一半软弱，戴兹，你就把我

装在轨道探测炮里发射出去。

GD_ConstructionYard_CannonMerge.en: CASSAVA: Our next step will be to send Privet up to the Orbital Probe Cannon to install the probe tracking system.
GD_ConstructionYard_CannonMerge.zh:
卡萨瓦：下一步，我们要把普利维特送上轨道探测炮

来安装探测跟踪系统。

GD_ConstructionYard_CannonMerge.en: DAZ: If I know my brother, Avens (and his spouse) will want to launch the probe with as much power as possible. I’m worried the cannon would break under the strain.
GD_ConstructionYard_CannonMerge.zh:
戴兹：我了解我的兄弟，埃文斯（和他的配偶）会动用一切可能的动力来

发射探测器。我担心大炮会承受不住而坏掉。

GD_ConstructionYard_CannonMerge.en: DAZ: I propose we give Avens and Mallow a slightly lower maximum power setting than the absolute maximum possible to create room for their enthusiasm.
GD_ConstructionYard_CannonMerge.zh:
戴兹：我建议我们给埃文斯和玛罗分配动力的时候，在最大绝对值的基础

上稍微做一点削减，为他们的工作热忱创造一些空间。

GD_ConstructionYard_LaunchReport.en: <TimeMinutes> MINUTES, <TimeSeconds> SECONDS AGO: Long-range probe successfully launched from the Orbital Probe Cannon.
GD_ConstructionYard_LaunchReport.zh: <TimeMinutes>分钟<TimeSeconds>秒之前：轨道探测炮发射远程探测器成功。

GD_Quantum_Entrance_1.en: Be welcomed in this place. This tower shares with all who ask the knowledge needed to make his or her first quantum journey.
GD_Quantum_Entrance_1.zh:
欢迎来到这个地方。这座高塔有求必应，会和任何人分享他或者她踏上

第一次量子之旅需要了解的知识。

GD_Quantum_Entrance_2.en: Enter this place without friends, however; these are lessons to learn for yourself.
GD_Quantum_Entrance_2.zh: 但是，只能孤身进入；其中的道理你要自己去领会。

GD_Quantum_FinalRoom.en: We offer our congratulations! You’ve learned the rule of quantum imaging. Take this knowledge with you on the remainder of your quantum pilgrimage.
GD_Quantum_FinalRoom.zh:
在此献上我们的祝贺！你已学会了量子成像法则。

就带着这个知识伴你度过余下的量子朝圣之旅。

GD_Quantum_FinalRoom.en: Remember, the other quantum shards have other lessons to teach.
GD_Quantum_FinalRoom.zh: 记住，其它的内容可以从别的量子碎片那里学习。

GD_Quantum_FinalRoom.en: Our curiosity goes with you on your journey. You walk in the footsteps of those who came before you, and your path guides those who will follow later.
GD_Quantum_FinalRoom.zh:
我们对你的旅程充满好奇心。你将跟随前人的脚步，

带领后人走向正确的道路。

GD_Quantum_PuzzleHint_2.en: Observing a quantum object; observing an image of a quantum object. These are the same.
GD_Quantum_PuzzleHint_2.zh: 观察一个量子对象；观察一个量子对象的图形。它们是一样的事情。

GD_Quantum_PuzzleHint_3.en: The arch and the crystal do not naturally meet.
GD_Quantum_PuzzleHint_3.zh: 拱门和水晶无法自然交汇。

GD_Quantum_PuzzleHint_4.en: This is the last one (but we made it harder).
GD_Quantum_PuzzleHint_4.zh: 这是最后一个（但是我们增加了难度）。

GD_StatueIsland_ConsciousnessDebate.en: PHLOX: I’m curious: Is sending a being’s memories back in time the same as sending the being itself back in time?
GD_StatueIsland_ConsciousnessDebate.zh:
弗拉克斯：我很好奇：把某个人的回忆送回到过去，

是不是就等于把这个人本身送回到过去？

GD_StatueIsland_ConsciousnessDebate.en: PHLOX: As an example, if we were to send my memories back in time, is that the same as sending “me” back in time (not my physical body, but my essence)?
GD_StatueIsland_ConsciousnessDebate.zh:
弗拉克斯：比方说，如果我们把我的回忆送回到过去，是不是就等于

把“我”送回到了过去（不是我的肉体，而是我的灵魂）？

GD_StatueIsland_ConsciousnessDebate.en: DAZ: I imagine they’re two different actions.
CASSAVA: Wouldn’t both actions be effectively the same?
GD_StatueIsland_ConsciousnessDebate.zh: 卡萨瓦：难道两者的本质不是一样的吗？

GD_StatueIsland_ConsciousnessDebate.en: DAZ: Suppose that time was being rewritten. I believe this is different than receiving memories from what is effectively the future.
GD_StatueIsland_ConsciousnessDebate.zh:
戴兹：估计那段时间会被改写。我认为这和从真正的未来那里获得回忆

不是一回事。

GD_StatueIsland_ConsciousnessDebate.en: CASSAVA: But isn’t the end result identical in either case?
GD_StatueIsland_ConsciousnessDebate.zh: 卡萨瓦：可不管怎么说，最后的结果不是一样的吗？

GD_StatueIsland_FirstMemoryStatueTest.en: PHLOX: Yarrow, would you kindly step back so Daz is closest to the statue? When pairing, the statue will choose whoever is in closest proximity.
GD_StatueIsland_FirstMemoryStatueTest.zh:
弗拉克斯：亚罗，能不能请你退后一点？这样戴兹才能距离雕像最近。

到时候，雕像会选择最近的人来进行匹配。

GD_StatueIsland_FirstMemoryStatueTest.en: PHLOX: ...See how its eyes have opened? That tells us the statue has paired with Daz. Now, no matter where he is in this star system, Daz’s statue will record his memories and send them to the Ash Twin Project.
GD_StatueIsland_FirstMemoryStatueTest.zh:
弗拉克斯：……看见它睁开眼睛的样子了吗？这说明雕像已经

和戴兹进行了匹配。现在，不管戴兹处在这个星系的什么地

方，

雕像都会把他的回忆记录下来，并发往灰烬双星计划。

GD_StatueIsland_FirstMemoryStatueTest.en: YARROW: This is extraordinary sculpting work, Phlox!
GD_StatueIsland_FirstMemoryStatueTest.zh: 亚罗：弗拉克斯，你的这座雕像真是非凡！

GD_StatueIsland_FirstMemoryStatueTest.en: DAZ: He has outdone himself again, hasn’t he? And now that we have our first successful pairing, we can test my memory storage prototype.
GD_StatueIsland_FirstMemoryStatueTest.zh:
戴兹：他再次突破了自己，对不对？既然第一例匹配已经成

功，

那么我们现在可以测试一下我的回忆存储原型了。

GD_StatueIsland_FirstMemoryStatueTest.en: DAZ: Each statue will send a single Nomai’s memories to his or her own storage unit within Ash Twin.
GD_StatueIsland_FirstMemoryStatueTest.zh:
戴兹：每座雕像都会把一个挪麦人的回忆发送到他或者她自己位于

灰烬双星的存储单元里。

GD_StatueIsland_FirstMemoryStatueTest.en: PHLOX: Each storage unit will be equipped with a mask, the statue’s counterpart, which will be able to send those stored memories back to the corresponding Nomai.
GD_StatueIsland_FirstMemoryStatueTest.zh:
弗拉克斯：每个存储单元都配有和雕像成对的面具，

可以将那些存储起来的回忆重新发送给相应的挪麦人。

GD_StatueIsland_WarpReceiverNote.en: PHLOX: Welcome to Giant’s Deep, friends! I’m excited for you to meet the statues!
GD_StatueIsland_WarpReceiverNote.zh: 弗拉克斯：欢迎来到深巨星，朋友们！你们能来参观雕像我十分高兴！

GD_StatueIsland_WarpReceiverNote.en: PHLOX: If I’m not in my dwelling, I’m likely in my workshop below (inside the island).
GD_StatueIsland_WarpReceiverNote.zh:
弗拉克斯：如果我不在住所，

那么多半就在下面（岛屿里头）的车间里。

GD_StatueIsland_WindowNote.en: LAMI: They’re going to test the memory statues tonight! Phlox says it could be dangerous, so we can’t come.
GD_StatueIsland_WindowNote.zh:
拉米：他们今天晚上要去测试回忆雕像！弗拉克斯说现场可能会很危险，

所以我们不能去。

GD_StatueIsland_WindowNote.en: LAMI: But, what if we didn’t use the door and snuck in the other way? Does anyone want to?
GD_StatueIsland_WindowNote.zh:
拉米：不过，假如我们不走大门，从别的地方摸进去呢？

有谁想去吗？

GD_StatueIsland_WindowNote.en: TAGET: Phlox specifically told us not to do that.
GD_StatueIsland_WindowNote.zh: 塔格特：弗拉克斯特别跟我们强调过别那么做。

GD_StatueIsland_WindowNote.en: LAEVI: I really want to see the test, too, Lami, but that’s a huge risk to take. We probably shouldn’t. Maybe Phlox’ll let us see a later test.
GD_StatueIsland_WindowNote.zh:
莱阿维：我也非常想去看看试验的情况，拉米，但是这样做太冒险了。

也许我们不该去。也许弗拉克斯会让我们去参观一次后期试验。

OPC_Intact_DamageReport.en: ORBITAL PROBE CANNON DAMAGE REPORT: Severe structural stress detected. Assessing damage to modules...
OPC_Intact_DamageReport.zh:
轨道探测炮损坏报告：检测到严重结构压力。

正在评估模块受损情况……

OPC_Intact_DamageReport.en: Control Module: Intact. No structural damage.
OPC_Intact_DamageReport.zh: 控制模块：完好。没有结构损伤。

OPC_Intact_DamageReport.en: Launch Module: Viewport window fractured. Module exposed to vacuum of space.
OPC_Intact_DamageReport.zh: 发射模块：观察窗碎裂。模块暴露在真空中。

OPC_Intact_HourglassOrdersReceived.en: <TimeMinutes> MINUTES, <TimeSeconds> SECONDS AGO: Request to launch probe received from Ash Twin Project.
OPC_Intact_HourglassOrdersReceived.zh: <TimeMinutes>分钟<TimeSeconds>秒之前：收到来自灰烬双星计划的探测器发射请求。

OPC_Intact_HourglassOrdersReceived.en: Cannon aligned with randomly selected probe trajectory. Gravity field activated.
OPC_Intact_HourglassOrdersReceived.zh: 大炮已经对准随机选择的探测器轨道。启动重力场。

OPC_Intact_LaunchReport.en: BEGIN LAUNCH LOG: Orbital Probe Cannon. Launch request received. Probe launch successful.
OPC_Intact_LaunchReport.zh:
发射日志开始：轨道探测

炮。收到发射请求。探测器发射成功。

OPC_Intact_LaunchReport.en: Probe Tracking Module is receiving data from probe.
OPC_Intact_LaunchReport.zh: 探测器跟踪模块正在接收探测器传来的数据。

OPC_Intact_LaunchReport.en: WARNING: Orbital Probe Cannon structure compromised during launch. Damage to multiple modules detected.
OPC_Intact_LaunchReport.zh: 警告：轨道探测炮在发射时结构遭到破坏。检测到多个模块受损。

OPC_Sunken_AllLaunchesData.en: Retrieving previous launch data from Ash Twin.
OPC_Sunken_AllLaunchesData.zh: 正在从灰烬双星获取之前的发射数据。

OPC_Sunken_AllLaunchesData.en: Deep space anomaly matching all known criteria for the Eye of the universe found by probe <FirstLoop>.
OPC_Sunken_AllLaunchesData.zh:
探测器<FirstLoop>发现与宇宙之眼

所有已知指标相符的深空异常现象。

OPC_Sunken_EyeCoordinates.en: Retrieving stored coordinates from Ash Twin.
OPC_Sunken_EyeCoordinates.zh: 正在从灰烬双星获取储存的坐标。

OPC_Sunken_EyeCoordinates.en: Displaying coordinates for the Eye of the universe.
OPC_Sunken_EyeCoordinates.zh: 正在显示宇宙之眼的坐标。

OPC_Sunken_LastLaunchData.zh: 正在接收探测器<NbTimeloops>传来的数据。
正在描绘探测器<NbTimeloops>的当前轨道。

QM_Shrine_QuantumClues_1.en: You have recalled the rule of quantum imaging.
QM_Shrine_QuantumClues_1.zh: 你已经回想起了量子成像法则。

QM_Shrine_QuantumClues_2.en: Recall the rule of quantum entanglement.

QM_Shrine_QuantumClues_3.en: Recall the rule of the sixth location.

QM_Shuttle_IlexRecording.en: SOLANUM: I am here! After watching it wander the skies for so long, I am about to stand (for the first time) on the Quantum Moon.
QM_Shuttle_IlexRecording.zh:
所莱内姆：我到了！一直以来，我都看着量子卫星在天空中流浪。

如今我即将（第一次）踏上它的表面。

QM_Shuttle_IlexRecording.en: SOLANUM: As expected, my shuttle has landed at the moon’s south pole. I will make the remainder of my journey on foot.
QM_Shuttle_IlexRecording.zh:
所莱内姆：和预想中一样，我的航天飞机已经降落在了卫星的南极。

剩下的路我就步行吧。

QM_Shuttle_IlexRecording.en: SOLANUM: We don’t know why the Quantum Moon always welcomes its visitors at the south pole, just that this is true.
QM_Shuttle_IlexRecording.zh:
所莱内姆：不知道为什么，凡是造访量子卫星的人，都会在南极降落。

我只知道，这事从来都没有过例外。

QM_Shuttle_IlexRecording.en: SOLANUM: As a child, I considered such unknowns sinister. Now, though, I understand they bear no ill will. The universe is, and we are.
QM_Shuttle_IlexRecording.zh:
所莱内姆：我还小的时候，觉得这种让人无法理解的事情都很可疑。

可现在，我明白了，其实谁也没有恶意。宇宙如此，我们也是一样。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Eye.en: SOLANUM: There is fundamental uncertainty throughout the universe. Normally, this uncertainty is only observable on a very small scale. As one approaches the Eye, however, that uncertainty grows enormously.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Eye.zh:
所莱内姆：整个宇宙遍布基础不确定性。一般来说，这种不确定性只能

在非常微小的尺度上才能被观察到。但是，当有人接近眼的时候，

它就会急剧放大。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Eye.en: SOLANUM: The Quantum Moon probably exhibits macroscopic quantum behavior because of its proximity to the Eye. Shards that broke off from the Quantum Moon have a similar effect, as I imagine you’ve seen elsewhere in this star system.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Eye.zh:
所莱内姆：量子卫星很可能是因为接近眼，所以才在宏观尺度上

表现出了量子行为。从量子卫星上分离出来的碎片拥有类似的特性。

我想你已经在这个星系的其它地方见到过了。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Eye.en: SOLANUM: Conscious observation forces a quantum object to collapse to a single possibility. But what would happen if a conscious observer somehow entered the Eye itself?
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Eye.zh:
所莱内姆：对一个量子对象进行有意识地观察，将会使其坍缩为单一的

可能态。但要是一个有意识的观察者进入眼，那么又会发生什么事情呢？

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Eye.en: SOLANUM: Over time, this has become my clan’s greatest question.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Eye.zh: 所莱内姆：渐渐地，这个问题成为了我的家族最大的疑问。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Me.en: SOLANUM: I imagine your purpose here is the same as mine: to learn about and to find the Eye of the universe.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Me.zh: 所莱内姆：我想你和我的目的一样：来这里了解并寻找宇宙之眼。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Me.en: SOLANUM: I’m unsure how you arrived here, however. Perhaps you came from another star system, as my clan originally did?
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Me.zh:
所莱内姆：不过，我不知道你是怎么来到这里的。

也许你也来自于别的星系？就和我的家族一开始那样。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Quantum.en: SOLANUM: Have you encountered a quantum shard on another planet? The shards look the same as the Quantum Moon’s surface does now, while at the Eye.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Quantum.zh:
所莱内姆：你有没有在其它行星上遇到过量子碎片？那些碎片的样子，

就和现在量子卫星位于眼时其表面所展现出来的外观一样。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Quantum.en: SOLANUM: From this, we can reasonably infer the Quantum Moon’s natural state is as we see it now, and that the Eye is its primary location.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Quantum.zh:
所莱内姆：借此有理由推断，我们目前看到的就是量子卫星

的自然状态。并且眼是它的主要运动位置。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Quantum.en: SOLANUM: Given the Quantum Moon is the Eye’s moon, it’s likely that any characteristics the moon exhibits are also exhibited by the Eye itself. The Quantum Moon and its shards, for instance, are quantum; thus, the Eye is likely also quantum.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Quantum.zh:
所莱内姆：鉴于量子卫星是眼的卫星，那么很可能眼也会

具备卫星所展现出来的所有特性。比如说，量子卫星及其

碎片是量子态的；因此，眼很可能也是量子态的。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Quantum.en: SOLANUM: In fact, this moon is probably quantum because its proximity to the Eye made it quantum, the same way the areas surrounding quantum shards that landed on other planets eventually became quantum, too.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+Quantum.zh:
所莱内姆：事实上，这颗卫星或许是因为接近眼，

所以才具备了量子特性。坠落在其它行星上的量子碎片

会对周遭的环境造成同样的影响，也是这个道理。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+You.en: SOLANUM: I am on my first pilgrimage to the Quantum Moon. All Nomai in my clan make this journey when we come of age.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+You.zh:
所莱内姆：我正要前往量子卫星，进行首次朝圣。在我的家族里，

所有的挪麦人一旦到了足够的年纪，都会踏上这样的旅

程。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+You.en: SOLANUM: Even though the Eye cannot be reached from here, the Quantum Moon remains special to us, as it carries us nearer to the Eye than any other place we know.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+You.zh:
所莱内姆：虽然从这里无法抵达眼，但量子卫星对我们而言依然

意义非凡。和别的地方相比，它可以带着我们来到最为靠近眼的地方。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+You.en: SOLANUM: I’ve journeyed here to be close to the Eye. While the Eye is obscured from our sight, we can see the Quantum Moon’s reflection of the Eye in the sky above us.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Explain+You.zh:
所莱内姆：我一路跋涉来到这里，为的就是接近眼。

虽然无法直接观察到眼，但是我们可以在上方的天空里看到

眼在量子卫星上的倒影。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+Me.en: SOLANUM: Suppose you could reach the Eye of the universe: Would you try to enter it?
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+Me.zh: 所莱内姆：假如你能够到达宇宙之眼：你会想办法进去吗？

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+Me.en: SOLANUM: What do you imagine the effects of a conscious observer might be?
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+Me.zh: 所莱内姆：你觉得有意识的观察者可能会造成怎样的影响？

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+QuantumMoon.en: SOLANUM: I imagine you’ve noticed the Quantum Moon changes in appearance depending on which location it is currently orbiting (for instance, the moon looks quite different when orbiting Giant's Deep than it does when orbiting the Hourglass Twins).
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+QuantumMoon.zh:
所莱内姆：我想你已经注意到了，根据量子卫星当前环绕的

轨道不同，它的外观也会发生变化（比如说，卫星在环绕深巨星

的时候和环绕沙漏双星的时候，样子是完全不一样的）。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+QuantumMoon.en: SOLANUM: Because the Quantum Moon clearly changes in its different forms, the Eye (being this moon’s primary location) must be similarly malleable.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+QuantumMoon.zh:
所莱内姆：因为量子卫星会在不同的形态之间产生变化，

那么眼（该卫星的主要运动位置）一定也具备类似的可变性。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+QuantumMoon.en: SOLANUM: From this, we can hypothesize that the Eye represents extreme changeability.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+QuantumMoon.zh:
所莱内姆：由此，我们可以假设眼将会表现出异常多变的特

性。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+QuantumMoon.en: SOLANUM: That said, despite its malleable nature, the Quantum Moon becomes locked to one specific version of itself when it is consciously observed.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+QuantumMoon.zh:
所莱内姆：也就是说，虽然量子卫星具有可变的特性，

但在受到有意识的观察时，它会固定在某个具体的性态上。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+QuantumMoon.en: SOLANUM: But what would happen if a conscious observer were to enter the Eye?
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+QuantumMoon.zh:
所莱内姆：但要是一个有意识的观察者进入眼，

那么又会发生什么事情呢？

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+You.en: SOLANUM: Many in my clan have believed the Eye called to us for a particular purpose.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+You.zh: 所莱内姆：我的家族里有许多人相信眼呼叫我们是有特殊原因的。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+You.en: SOLANUM: When I was a child, I used to believe the Eye was malevolent, to have lured my clan to this star system only to then vanish from them so completely.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+You.zh:
所莱内姆：小的时候，我以为眼不怀好意，

想把我的家族引到这个星系来，好把我们彻底铲除。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+You.en: SOLANUM: But I don’t fear the Eye, anymore. In fact, it became my fondest hope to see the Eye itself, someday, but I fear this may be beyond my reach.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+You.zh:
所莱内姆：不过我已经不再害怕眼了。事实上，

有朝一日能够亲自看到眼已经成了我最大的心愿。

不过恐怕我将无法实现这个愿望。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+You.en: SOLANUM: You may think I’m strange, but I have a hypothesis that I may not be entirely alive. Perhaps my journey has reached its end.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Eye+You.zh:
所莱内姆：你可能会觉得我说这话很奇怪，不过我有一个假

设，

那就是我可能只是部分地活着。也许我的旅程已经走到了终点。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Identify+Explai.en: SOLANUM: These are the two tenets of Nomai philosophy; to seek out and to understand is our way of living.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Identify+Explai.zh: 所莱内姆：挪麦人信奉两大人生信条；寻找和理解是我们生命的意义。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Identify+Eye.en: SOLANUM: We are orbiting the Eye of the universe now, although we cannot see it (only the Quantum Moon’s reflection of it). The Eye is older than the universe itself, and my clan believes it dwells in an extremely distant orbit around this star system.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Identify+Eye.zh:
所莱内姆：我们现在正在环绕宇宙之眼的轨道上。不过我们无法

看见它（只能看见它在量子卫星上的倒影）。眼比宇宙本身

还要古老。我的家族认为它处在一个十分遥远的轨道上环绕这个星系。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Identify+Me.en: SOLANUM: I’ve never met one of your kind before. It’s an honor to speak with you! I particularly admire your four eyes.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Identify+Me.zh:
所莱内姆：我以前从来没有遇见过你们种族的人。

能够和你交谈我十分荣幸！我特别喜欢你的四只眼睛。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Identify+Me.en: SOLANUM: There are many questions I would ask, if I could comprehend your language. You have my gratitude for understanding mine.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Identify+Me.zh:
所莱内姆：要是我能够理解你们的语言就好了。

我有许多问题想要问。你能够听懂我说的话，我实在是感激不尽。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Identify+Quantu.en: SOLANUM: This is the Quantum Moon, where we both are standing.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Identify+Quantu.zh: 所莱内姆：我们所站的地方叫做量子卫星。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Identify+Quantu.en: SOLANUM: Despite also orbiting other celestial bodies, the Quantum Moon is the Eye of the universe’s moon.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Identify+Quantu.zh:
所莱内姆：量子卫星是宇宙之眼的卫星，

但它也会围绕其它天体运动。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Identify+You.en: SOLANUM: I am Solanum, a Nomai. My clan arrived in this star system before my birth, and we now call it home.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_Identify+You.zh:
所莱内姆：我叫所莱内姆，是一名挪麦人。在我出生之前，

我的家族就来到了这个星系。如今，我们在这里安了家。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_QuantumMoon+Me.en: SOLANUM: Is this your first time on the Quantum Moon? It’s my first time here.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_QuantumMoon+Me.zh: 所莱内姆：你是第一次来到量子卫星吗？我是第一次来。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_QuantumMoon+Me.en: SOLANUM: If you’ve come here looking for answers, I hope you find them.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_QuantumMoon+Me.zh: 所莱内姆：如果你是来寻找答案的，希望你能够如愿以偿。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_QuantumMoon+You.en: SOLANUM: Like many of my clan before me, I journeyed here to see the Quantum Moon’s reflection of the Eye. This is the closest any of us have come to seeing the Eye itself.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_QuantumMoon+You.zh:
所莱内姆：我和之前的许多族人一样，来这里想要看看眼在

量子卫星上的倒影。这是我们对眼进行的最近一次观察。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_QuantumMoon+You.en: SOLANUM: You may think I’m strange, but I have a hypothesis that I may not be entirely alive. Perhaps my journey has reached its end.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_QuantumMoon+You.zh:
所莱内姆：你可能会觉得我说这话很奇怪，不过我有一个假

设，

那就是我可能只是部分地活着。也许我的旅程已经走到了终点。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_You+Me.en: SOLANUM: We do not have much connection, you and I.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_You+Me.zh: 所莱内姆：你我之间没有太多的共同点。

QM_SolanumConvo_Response_You+Me.en: SOLANUM: Still, this encounter feels special. I hope you won’t mind if I think of you as a friend.
QM_SolanumConvo_Response_You+Me.zh:
所莱内姆：可是，这次相遇依然让我觉得非比寻常。

我想把你当成朋友，希望你不要介意。

SS_ApproximateTime.en: Star has reached end of natural life cycle. Now approaching red giant stage. WARNING: Evacuate Sun Station.
SS_ApproximateTime.zh:
恒星已到达其自然生命周期的最终阶段。即将进入红巨星阶

段。

警告：立即疏散太阳站。

SS_ApproximateTime.en:
Approximate time until Sun Station is destroyed by expanding star: <RemainingMinutes> MINUTES, <RemainingSeconds> SECONDS

Approximate time until star’s death: <MinutesToRedGiant> MINUTES, <SecondsToRedGiant> SECONDS
SS_ApproximateTime.zh:
距太阳站被膨胀恒星吞噬预计还有<RemainingMinutes>分<RemainingSeconds>秒

距恒星死亡预计还有<MinutesToRedGiant>分<SecondsToRedGiant>秒

SS_ClosingEmergencyDoor.en: 281,042 YEARS AGO: No user commands received for 10 minutes. All systems entering sleep.
SS_ClosingEmergencyDoor.zh:
281,042年前：10分钟内没有收到用户命令。所有系统进入休

眠。

SS_ClosingEmergencyDoor.en: <TimeMinutes> MINUTES, <TimeSeconds> SECONDS AGO: Increased solar activity detected. Sun Station hull integrity approaching critical levels. Closing emergency doors.
SS_ClosingEmergencyDoor.zh:
<TimeMinutes>分钟<TimeSeconds>秒之前：检测到太阳活动增加。

太阳站结构完整度接近临界水平。正在关闭紧急逃生门。

SS_MissionStatement.en: PYE: Mission: Science compels us to explode the sun!
SS_MissionStatement.zh: 派伊：任务：科学迫使我们不得不引爆太阳！

SS_MissionStatement.en: IDAEA: Here’s a better one. Mission: Determine if it’s possible to prompt the sun to explode.
SS_MissionStatement.zh: 伊代亚：我有一个更合适的提法。任务：研究是否有可能促进太阳爆发。

SS_MissionStatement.en: IDAEA: Can’t we change this? I don’t enjoy working in view of such a morbid mission statement.
SS_MissionStatement.zh:
伊代亚：我们能不能改一下？我不是很喜欢在这种不健全的任务宣言下

展开工作。

SS_MissionStatement.en: PYE: But it’s accurate. We’re going to create a supernova for the purpose of scientific progress. That’s our mission.
SS_MissionStatement.zh:
派伊：但是这个提法很贴切。我们要出于科学进步的目的制造一颗

超新星。那就是我们的任务。

SS_MissionStatement.en: IDAEA: Our mission is to decide if such an irresponsible feat is even possible.
SS_MissionStatement.zh: 伊代亚：我们的任务是考察这种不负责任的作为是否存在着可能性。

SS_MissionStatement.en: PYE: You lack a sense of humor.
SS_MissionStatement.zh: 派伊：你真是缺少幽默感。

SS_MissionStatement.en: IDAEA: At least I don’t lack a sense of ethics!
SS_MissionStatement.zh: 伊代亚：至少我的良心没有少！

SS_MissionStatement.en: PYE: Kindly refrain from going supernova on me before the sun does, Idaea.
SS_MissionStatement.zh:
派伊：请克制一下自己，伊代亚。太阳还没有爆发成超新星，

你可别先炸了。

Shared_BH_Cannon_BH_Quantum.en: SOLANUM: I’m at the shuttle! I’m ready to make my first pilgrimage to the Quantum Moon.
Shared_BH_Cannon_BH_Quantum.zh:
所莱内姆：我坐上了航天飞机！我准备好了。

我即将要前往量子卫星，进行首次朝圣。

Shared_BH_Cannon_BH_Quantum.en: BELLS: That’s exciting! You’re almost ready, but there’s still one more rule you need to learn. Come see me at the Tower of Quantum Knowledge.
Shared_BH_Cannon_BH_Quantum.zh:
贝尔斯：真是叫人激动！你差不多准备好了。

不过你还有一条法则需要学习。来量子知识之塔见我。

Shared_BH_Cannon_BH_Quantum.en: BELLS: The tower is on the opposite side of Brittle Hollow. If you follow the path west to the Crossroads, you can reach the tower from there.
Shared_BH_Cannon_BH_Quantum.zh:
贝尔斯：量子知识之塔在碎空星的另一头。

如果你沿着西边的路走到十字路口，就能从那儿前往量子知识之塔。

Shared_BH_Cannon_BH_Quantum.en: SOLANUM: My gratitude for the directions, Bells. I’ll see you soon!
Shared_BH_Cannon_BH_Quantum.zh: 所莱内姆：感谢你为我指路，贝尔斯。我们回头见！

Shared_BH_Forge_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: CLARY: I have good news, Yarrow! The advanced warp core is ready to be installed in the central chamber of Ash Twin.
Shared_BH_Forge_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh: 克莱瑞：亚罗，我带来了好消息！高级跃迁核心已经可以安装在灰烬双星的中央舱室中了。

Shared_BH_Forge_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: YARROW: I’m intrigued, love! Everyone here working on the Ash Twin Project is excited to see it (Pye is beside herself with joy!).
Shared_BH_Forge_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh: 亚罗：我非常感兴趣，亲爱的！参与灰烬双星计划的所有人都迫不及待了（派伊高兴得不得了！）。

Shared_BH_Forge_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: YARROW: Is everything well at the forge?
Shared_BH_Forge_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh: 亚罗：熔炉那里没出什么问题吧？

Shared_BH_Forge_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: CLARY: Don’t worry, love; Poke is only nervous. The core is extraordinary, and her design work is beautifully clever.
Shared_BH_Forge_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh: 克莱瑞：别担心，亲爱的；珀克只是情绪比较紧张。核心非比寻常，她的设计工作可以说是精妙绝顶。

Shared_BH_Forge_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: POKE: The core’s durability could still be improved! I need more time!
Shared_BH_Forge_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh: 珀克：核心的耐久度还需要改良！我需要更多时间！

Shared_BH_Forge_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: CLARY: Ignore her, Yarrow. The core is finished. And if my sister tells you otherwise, then she will be finished, as well.
Shared_BH_Forge_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh:
克莱瑞：别理她，亚罗。核心已经完成了。

假如我的妹妹不同意这个说法，那么她的工作也将到此为止。

Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_BH_Observator.en: CASSAVA: Conoy, Daz and I were lifting Orbital Probe Cannon components into orbit for assembly, and one somehow sank down down beneath the current.
Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_BH_Observator.zh:
卡萨瓦：科诺伊、戴兹和我正在将轨道探测炮的部件送往轨道

进行组装，可是其中一个不知怎么回事掉到了水流的下面去。

Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_BH_Observator.en: DAZ: Cassava convinced me not to try to recreate the phenomenon myself using other cannon parts, but we’re very curious to know what happened! How could something pass through the current?
Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_BH_Observator.zh:
戴兹：卡萨瓦让我不要用大炮的其它零件自己尝试再现这一现象。但我们非常想要知道到底发生了什么事！

怎么会有东西往水流下面掉呢？

Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_BH_Observator.en: CONOY: My gratitude for your interesting question! This is exciting: Spire constructed a model of Giant's Deep here at Brittle Hollow's Southern Observatory, and it reveals how an object might sink below the current.
Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_BH_Observator.zh:
科诺伊：我感谢你提出了这个有趣的问题！这真是激动人心：斯拜尔在碎空星的南部天文台这里构筑了一个深巨星的模型，

它告诉了我们为什么物体会沉到水流下面去。

Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_BH_Observator.en: CASSAVA: Conoy, I’m unable to grasp the answer by looking through the projection pool. If I visit the observatory, would you kindly explain?
Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_BH_Observator.zh:
卡萨瓦：科诺伊，光是看投影池我无法理解其中的原因。

如果我造访天文台，能不能请你给我解释一下？

Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_BH_Observator.en: CONOY: If you don’t mind the trek beneath the surface to the south pole, I’d be delighted to see you! (There are two trailheads, one at Brittle Hollow's gravity cannon and one at the Tower of Quantum Knowledge.)
Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_BH_Observator.zh:
科诺伊：如果你不介意从地表下面跋涉前往南极，

我将很高兴接待你！（有两个入口，一个在碎空星重力炮，一个在量子知识之塔。）

Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_BH_Observator.en: DAZ: Conoy, you should’ve seen it! We’d thought it was impossible for any cannon components to sink even partially below the current, but ours sank straight to the core!
Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_BH_Observator.zh:
戴兹：科诺伊，你真该来看看！我们本以为不管哪种大炮部

件，都绝对

不可能往水流的下面沉。然而我们的部件却直接沉到了核心里！

Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_OPC_Intact.en: CASSAVA: I have bad news, Avens. Yarrow says there was a problem with the proposed power source, so the Orbital Probe Cannon won’t be asked to fire.
Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_OPC_Intact.zh:
卡萨瓦：我有一些坏消息，埃文斯。亚罗说推荐的动力源出了问题，

无法请求轨道探测炮进行发射。

Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_OPC_Intact.en: AVENS: I hope you’re pulling my locomotive limb here, Cassava.
Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_OPC_Intact.zh: 埃文斯：但愿你是在跟我开玩笑，卡萨瓦。

Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_OPC_Intact.en: CASSAVA: I wish I were, my friend, but no. They aren’t certain they can fix the problem, so the Orbital Probe Cannon is on indefinite hiatus.
Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_OPC_Intact.zh:
卡萨瓦：要是真的是这样就好了。他们无法确定问题出在哪

儿，

也修不好，所以轨道探测炮只能无限期搁置。

Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_OPC_Intact.en: CASSAVA: Tell Privet and Mallow they should return from the cannon. My spouse and I will remain at the Construction Yard, for now.
Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_OPC_Intact.zh:
卡萨瓦：告诉普利维特和玛罗，让他们从大炮那儿回来。

我的配偶和我暂时要留在建造厂。

Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_OPC_Intact.en: AVENS: An update: Mallow and I will join you and Daz. Privet left to visit her brother. She fears Idaea may feel responsible.
Shared_GD_ConstructionYard_OPC_Intact.zh:
埃文斯：更新：玛罗和我会来找你和戴兹。

普利维特去找她的兄弟了。她担心伊代亚会有自责情绪。

Shared_GD_StatueIsland_TT_TimeLoopInteri.en: RAMIE: I’ve installed the masks inside the Ash Twin Project, Phlox. They look beautiful (although I do feel as though I’m being observed!).
Shared_GD_StatueIsland_TT_TimeLoopInteri.zh:
瑞米：弗拉克斯，我已经安装好了灰烬双星计划内部的面具。

它们看上去很漂亮（不过我觉得它们好像在观察我！）。

Shared_GD_StatueIsland_TT_TimeLoopInteri.en: RAMIE: It’s comforting to know the statues will not pair until the project succeeds. Otherwise, I imagine the experience would be hard to endure!
Shared_GD_StatueIsland_TT_TimeLoopInteri.zh:
瑞米：还好雕像在计划成功之前不会进行匹配。

不然的话，那一定是叫人难以忍受的体验！

Shared_GD_StatueIsland_TT_TimeLoopInteri.en: PHLOX: Ideally, they’ll only need to activate once the project succeeds; as a safety measure, however, the statues will also activate in the event of equipment failure.
Shared_GD_StatueIsland_TT_TimeLoopInteri.zh:
弗拉克斯：理想的情况下，我们只需要在计划成功时启动它

们；

不过作为安全措施，这些雕像也会在设备出现故障的时候被启动。

Shared_GD_StatueIsland_TT_TimeLoopInteri.en: RAMIE: They will? Why is that?
Shared_GD_StatueIsland_TT_TimeLoopInteri.zh: 瑞米：真的吗？那是为什么？

Shared_GD_StatueIsland_TT_TimeLoopInteri.en: PHLOX: If anything goes wrong with the Ash Twin Project, the statues (and their masks) will make us aware of the situation and enable us to fix it. Otherwise, it would be possible for us to remain permanently unaware of the problem.
Shared_GD_StatueIsland_TT_TimeLoopInteri.zh:
弗拉克斯：如果灰烬双星计划出现问题，雕像（还有它们的面具）

可以把情况通知给我们，让我们进行修复。

不然的话，我们就可能永远也不知道出了什么问题。

Shared_GD_StatueIsland_TT_TimeLoopInteri.en: RAMIE: I hadn’t thought of that! What a profoundly horrific fate that would be.
Shared_GD_StatueIsland_TT_TimeLoopInteri.zh: 瑞米：这我倒是没想过！那将会多么可怕的情况啊。

Shared_OPC_Damaged_OPC_Sunken.en: MALLOW: Imagine, Privet: the Probe Tracking Module will be the first to know the coordinates of the Eye of the universe! You’ll be the first to see them!
Shared_OPC_Damaged_OPC_Sunken.zh:
玛罗：想想看，普利维特：探测器跟踪模块将会头一个获取

宇宙之眼的坐标！而你则是第一个得知这一坐标的人！

Shared_OPC_Damaged_OPC_Sunken.en: PRIVET: I am honored and terrified!
Shared_OPC_Damaged_OPC_Sunken.zh: 普利维特：我深感荣幸，惶恐之至！

Shared_OPC_Damaged_OPC_Sunken.en: PRIVET: You won’t ask the Orbital Probe Cannon to use so much power that it breaks, will you?
Shared_OPC_Damaged_OPC_Sunken.zh:
普利维特：你不会让轨道探测炮动用太多动力，把它给弄坏

吧？

Shared_OPC_Damaged_OPC_Sunken.en: MALLOW: Fret not, my nervous friend! We only need to fire the probe once, anyway, so who minds if it compromises the Orbital Probe Cannon’s structural integrity slightly?
Shared_OPC_Damaged_OPC_Sunken.zh:
玛罗：别紧张，我爱操心的朋友！反正我们只会发射一次探测器，

就算是轨道探测炮的结构有轻微的损坏，又会有谁在乎

呢？

Shared_OPC_Damaged_OPC_Sunken.en: PRIVET: I would mind, Mallow! I would mind, because we won’t be capable of receiving our probe’s data if the Probe Tracking Module is destroyed!
Shared_OPC_Damaged_OPC_Sunken.zh:
普利维特：我在乎，玛罗！我在乎，因为要是探测器跟踪模块损毁，

那我们就没法接受探测器传来的数据了！

Shared_OPC_Intact_OPC_Damaged.en: AVENS: Mallow, my better 50 percent! Cassava is sending the last of the cannon components. Soon (relatively speaking), we’ll know the Eye’s precise location!
Shared_OPC_Intact_OPC_Damaged.zh:
埃文斯：玛罗，我的另一半！卡萨瓦把最后一批大炮部件给送了过来。

很快（相对而言），我们就会知道眼的确切位置了！

Shared_OPC_Intact_OPC_Damaged.en: MALLOW: The thought of concluding our elders’ curious and challenging search increases my heart’s temperature, my love!
Shared_OPC_Intact_OPC_Damaged.zh:
玛罗：一想到能够解开前人的谜题，结束这次艰难的搜索，

我就心跳不止，我的爱人！

Shared_OPC_Intact_OPC_Damaged.en: AVENS: Cassava tells me he and the Construction Yard crew have determined a power setting we are not, under any circumstances, to go above.
Shared_OPC_Intact_OPC_Damaged.zh:
埃文斯：卡萨瓦告诉我，他和建造厂的人员已经规定了动力设置

的上限。不管什么情况，我们都不能超出这个上限。

Shared_OPC_Intact_OPC_Damaged.en: MALLOW: I see! And am I right to think that, consequently, we’ll be ignoring that setting?
Shared_OPC_Intact_OPC_Damaged.zh: 玛罗：我懂了！我是不是由此可以推断，我们要无视这样的设置？

Shared_OPC_Intact_OPC_Damaged.en: AVENS: I can posit with nearly 100 percent certainty our friends have accounted for our natures, so I suggest we do!
Shared_OPC_Intact_OPC_Damaged.zh:
埃文斯：我可以百分之一百地假定，我们的朋友已经把我们的本性给

考虑了进去，因此我认为我们应该无视这一设置！

Shared_OPC_Intact_OPC_Damaged.en: AVENS: Giving the Orbital Probe Cannon all the power it can structurally withstand creates the greatest chance of finding the Eye of the universe.
Shared_OPC_Intact_OPC_Damaged.zh:
埃文斯：把动力提高到轨道探测炮结构所能承受的极限，

就可以最大限度地增加发现宇宙之眼的机会。

Shared_OPC_Intact_OPC_Damaged.en: MALLOW: Yes, the probe must travel as fast as it can, as far as it can. I’ll make some adjustments!
Shared_OPC_Intact_OPC_Damaged.zh:
玛罗：是的，探测器一定要飞得尽可能快，尽可能远才行。

我这就来进行调整！

Shared_OPC_Sunken_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: YARROW: I have exciting news, Privet: The Ash Twin Project is almost prepared to receive the probe data from the Orbital Probe Cannon.
Shared_OPC_Sunken_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh:
亚罗：我有一些激动人心的消息，普利维特：灰烬双星计划

即将准备就绪，可以接受轨道探测炮传来的探测器数据了。

Shared_OPC_Sunken_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: YARROW: Ramie is adding some finishing touches here, but she’ll be finished soon. Are you and the Orbital Probe Cannon well?
Shared_OPC_Sunken_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh:
亚罗：瑞米正在做最后的收尾工作，不过她马上就能完工。

你和轨道探测炮都没问题吧？

Shared_OPC_Sunken_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: PRIVET: We are! The statue here in the Probe Tracking Module is ready to record each launch’s flight trajectory and will automatically transmit all relevant data to you.
Shared_OPC_Sunken_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh:
普利维特：没问题！探测器跟踪模块已经就绪，

能够记录每次发射的飞行轨迹，并且会把相关的数据自动传给你。

Shared_OPC_Sunken_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: PRIVET: Once the probe determines the location of the Eye of the universe, I’ll send an alert directly to you and Ramie.
Shared_OPC_Sunken_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh:
普利维特：一旦探测器发现宇宙之眼的位置，

我就会直接通知你和瑞米。

Shared_OPC_Sunken_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: PRIVET: On the other appendage, I’m now worried about this cannon’s structural integrity and its crew’s moral integrity.
Shared_OPC_Sunken_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh:
普利维特：而另一方面，我现在担心的是这门大炮的

结构还有乘员的精神是不是健全。

Shared_SS_SunStation_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: YARROW: What happened? Did the Sun Station not fire?
Shared_SS_SunStation_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh: 亚罗：怎么回事？太阳站没有进行发射吗？

Shared_SS_SunStation_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: PYE: It fired, Yarrow. But it failed. The sun barely responded; there were infintestimally small surface-level changes, but they were barely visible, even to the third eye.
Shared_SS_SunStation_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh:
派伊：它发射了，亚罗。但是没有成功。太阳基本上没有回

应；只是

在表面水平产生了极其微弱的变化，就连第三只眼也几乎难以观察到。

Shared_SS_SunStation_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: PYE: The Sun Station is useless. It will never, and could never, cause the sun to explode.
Shared_SS_SunStation_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh:
派伊：太阳站不起作用。它现在不能，

以后也无法引爆太阳

了。

Shared_SS_SunStation_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: PYE: I don’t know what comes next, my friends. I suppose we must start over, but I’m unsure how to start over.
Shared_SS_SunStation_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh:
派伊：我不知道接下来该怎么办，我的朋友们。我建议我们重头开始，

但我不知道该怎么重头开始。

Shared_SS_SunStation_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: YARROW: Return to Ash Twin first, my friend. Perhaps a change of task would help: Spire noticed a comet approaching this star system that we’d like to investigate.
Shared_SS_SunStation_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh:
亚罗：首先，回到灰烬双星，我的朋友。也许换个工作可以让你恢复

过来：斯拜尔发现有一颗彗星正在靠近这个星系，我们要去调查一下。

Shared_SS_SunStation_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: YARROW: Pye... I hurt for you, my friends; we all know how hard you’ve both worked. I can only offer my compassion. How are you? How is Idaea?
Shared_SS_SunStation_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh:
亚罗：派伊……我为你们感到难过，我的朋友们；我们都知道你们俩

有多辛苦。我只能表示同情。你还好吗？伊代亚还好

吗？

Shared_SS_SunStation_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: IDAEA: We’re well, Yarrow (or as well as can be expected, given the circumstances), though disappointed. I may have disagreed with exploding the sun, but I never wished the device would fail. I’d hoped our terrible work was finished.
Shared_SS_SunStation_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh:
伊代亚：我们很好，亚罗（或者说，鉴于目前的情况，好极了），

不过我们很失望。虽然我不赞同引爆太阳的方案，

但是我打心眼里希望设备能够成功。但愿我们可怕的工作到此为止。

Shared_TH_Mine_BHM_Volcano.en: ROOT: Friends in the Timber Hearth Mines, the last type of ore you sent us survives the longest in direct heat.
Shared_TH_Mine_BHM_Volcano.zh:
鲁特：木炉星矿井的各位朋友，你们寄给我们的矿石中，

最后一种在直接受热时坚持的时间最长。

Shared_TH_Mine_BHM_Volcano.en: ROOT: Can you send us more of the same for additional testing? We’re attempting to improve its durability, and our forge has already burned through everything you sent!
Shared_TH_Mine_BHM_Volcano.zh:
鲁特：能不能再寄来些这种矿石，好让我们再多做几次实验？

我们想把耐久度再提高点，可你们寄来的东西都已经烧光了！

Shared_TH_Mine_BHM_Volcano.en: OENO: We’ll deliver more ore to Hollow’s Lantern immediately. You must be fired up about crafting the Ash Twin Project’s protective shell!
Shared_TH_Mine_BHM_Volcano.zh:
奥埃诺：我们将立即把更多矿石寄往空心灯。

你们造起这个灰烬双星计划的保护外壳，还真是挺有干劲的嘛！

Shared_TH_Mine_BHM_Volcano.en: ROOT: Yes, the idea of an encasement that’s supernova-proof, however briefly, has kindled my curiosity!
Shared_TH_Mine_BHM_Volcano.zh: 鲁特：没错！隔绝超新星的保护壳，光是想到这个主意我就够兴奋的了！

Shared_TH_Mine_BHM_Volcano.en: ROOT: My gratitude! I imagine we’ll also have an updated estimate soon of how much ore is needed to seal off the Ash Twin Project.
Shared_TH_Mine_BHM_Volcano.zh:
鲁特：太感谢了！那么，关于完成灰烬双星计划所需的具体矿石数量，

想必近期就能向你们提供最新的估测结果。

Shared_TH_Mine_BHM_Volcano.en: OENO: Will it be more than we initially thought?
Shared_TH_Mine_BHM_Volcano.zh: 奥埃诺：会比我们最开始预计的还要多吗？

Shared_TH_Mine_BHM_Volcano.en: ROOT: It will be significantly more. The smallest crack or opening in the protective shell would destroy everything.
Shared_TH_Mine_BHM_Volcano.zh: 鲁特：多大发了。保护外壳哪怕裂了一丁点，一切努力就都白费了。

Shared_TH_Mine_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: YARROW: My gratitude for the latest shipment, Oeno! This ore should be the last we’ll need for the Ash Twin Project.
Shared_TH_Mine_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh: 亚罗：感谢你送来的上一批矿石，奥埃诺！这应该是灰烬双星计划需要的最后一批矿石了。

Shared_TH_Mine_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: YARROW: Once we’ve finished the shell that seals off the central chamber, we’ll check to ensure there are no longer any physical entrances. Ramie and I will be checking the interior and then the exterior for cracks (our final safety check).
Shared_TH_Mine_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh: 亚罗：密封中央舱室的外壳完成后，我们就会进行检查，确认上面没有任何能与内部物理接触的方式。瑞米和我会检查内外部有没有裂缝（这也是我们的最终安全检查）。

Shared_TH_Mine_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: OENO: This is exciting news! Can I offer an extra set of eyes for this final check (specifically, mine)? If my work here is complete, I’d be delighted to help.
Shared_TH_Mine_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh: 奥埃诺：这真是激动人心的好消息！最终检查能不能多加一个人（特别是我）？如果我在这里的工作完成了，我十分乐意给你们帮忙。

Shared_TH_Mine_TT_TimeLoopInterior.en: YARROW: We’d be grateful if you would! The more eyes, the better, as the smallest flaw or opening in the shell that protects the Ash Twin Project could lead to disaster.
Shared_TH_Mine_TT_TimeLoopInterior.zh:
亚罗：要是你能来帮忙，那可就太好了！来检查的人越多越

好。保护外壳上哪怕只有一个细微的瑕疵或开口，也会对灰烬双星计划造成灾难性的后果。

THM_SignalDish_1.en: COLEUS: I was upstairs testing the Eye signal locator, and it can hear and follow the signals from the sun, Giant’s Deep, and Brittle Hollow.
THM_SignalDish_1.zh:
科利耶斯：我正在楼上测试眼信号定位器，它可以接收并跟踪

太阳、深巨星，还有碎空星发出的信号。

THM_SignalDish_1.en: COLEUS: However, something strange is happening when I ask the Eye signal locator to follow the Eye’s signal: The device’s indicator rotates wildly and never points to just one direction.
THM_SignalDish_1.zh:
科利耶斯：但是，就在我让眼信号定位器跟踪眼信号的时候，\

发生了奇怪的事情：设备的指示器疯狂旋转，无法指向固定的方位。

THM_SignalDish_1.en: THATCH: This is a curious result. It’s possible the Eye has stopped calling out its signal.
THM_SignalDish_1.zh: 萨奇：真是个奇怪的结果。有可能眼停止发射信号了。

THM_SignalDish_1.en: FILIX: I see! I most likely calibrated the locator incorrectly. Privet (my apprentice) and I will make adjustments and try again.
THM_SignalDish_1.zh:
费利克斯：我懂了！我一定是没有把定位器校准好。普利维特（我的

徒弟）和我会进行调节，然后再试一次。

THM_SignalDish_1.en: FILIX: An update: Disappointingly, everything is correctly calibrated after all.
THM_SignalDish_1.zh: 费利克斯：更新：很遗憾，原来所有的内容都有校准好。

THM_SignalDish_1.en: CASSAVA: It saddens me to posit this, my friends, but I believe this locator cannot detect the Eye’s signal. We would need to build a more sensitive device if we want to locate the Eye of the universe.
THM_SignalDish_1.zh:
卡萨瓦：这么说让我很难过，我的朋友们，但是我相信这台眼信号定位器无法探测到眼的信号。我们需要建造一台

更加复杂的设备，才能找到宇宙之眼的确切位置。

THM_SignalDish_1.en: THATCH: Then we will build it. Don’t lose hope, Cassava; our search for the Eye is what brought our clan to this place. We won’t give up so easily!
THM_SignalDish_1.zh:
萨奇：那我们就造。不要灰心，卡萨瓦；正是因为要寻找眼，

我们的家族才来到了这里。我们是不会轻易放弃的！

THM_SignalDish_2.en: THATCH: Where should this new, more sophisticated locator be built? It may need to be larger than this Eye signal locator is.
THM_SignalDish_2.zh:
萨奇：这台更加复杂的新型定位器要建在哪里？占地规模可能得比

眼信号定位器要大。

THM_SignalDish_2.en: PLUME: The southern glacier on Brittle Hollow has ample available space. I could construct a new building to house this proposed locator.
THM_SignalDish_2.zh:
普鲁姆：碎空星的南部冰川拥有充足的可用空间。

我可以在那里新建一栋建筑来安置这台定位器。

THM_SignalDish_2.en: FILIX: Yes, let’s build there! I imagine our young friend Conoy would enjoy that immensely. He’s always held a great interest in the Eye, especially for a child born so long after the crash.
THM_SignalDish_2.zh:
费利克斯：好的，就建在那里吧！我想我们年轻的朋友科诺伊一定会非常

喜欢。作为一个坠机之后出生的孩子，他一向对眼兴趣盎然。

THM_SignalDish_2.en: PLUME: I will begin construction on Brittle Hollow’s south pole immediately, then!
THM_SignalDish_2.zh: 普鲁姆：那么，我马上就去碎空星的南极开工！

THM_SignalDish_2.en: COLEUS: Annona and those of us originally stranded on Ember Twin built a Quantum Moon locator there, but the heat of the sun made its construction challenging. I wouldn’t recommend building on that planet.
THM_SignalDish_2.zh:
科利耶斯：安诺纳还有我们一开始被困在余烬双星的人在那里造了

一台量子卫星定位器，可是太阳的热辐射让工程变得十分艰难。

我不建议在那颗行星上进行建造。

TH_Mine_FindingHearthianLife.en: COLEUS: After closer observation, mining site 2a wouldn’t be safe for the native life dwelling in some of this cave’s pools, so (unfortunately) we’ll have to mine one of the other sites.
TH_Mine_FindingHearthianLife.zh:
科利耶斯：在经过更加近距离的观察之后，采矿点2a已经不适合当地生命

在这个洞窟的某些池塘里居住了，因此（很遗

憾），我们只能去其它地点

展开开采工作。

TH_Mine_FindingHearthianLife.en: COLEUS: On the opposite hand, new life! This species is semi-aquatic, and very hardy. The ecosystem here is quite robust, so I believe they’ll thrive in the long run. Be cautious near the pools if you visit 2a to meet them.
TH_Mine_FindingHearthianLife.zh:
科利耶斯：而另一方面，这意味着出现了新的生命！这是一种半水生

物种，而且适应力极强。这里的生态系统相当坚挺，因此我相信

假以时日，它们一定可以茁壮繁衍。假如你来2a参观这些生物，

靠近池塘的时候要当心。

TH_Mine_FindingHearthianLife.en: CYCAD: There are a few other cave sites that look promising. What about site 2b (it shares similar formations and strata)?
TH_Mine_FindingHearthianLife.zh:
赛卡德：有几个洞窟看上去可以满足条件。2b这个位置怎么样（那里的

地质结构和岩层与2a类似）？

TH_Mine_FindingHearthianLife.en: OENO: This sounds promising! Will you and your mentor investigate? If mining site 2b proves safe for this native species, we’ll move our work there.
TH_Mine_FindingHearthianLife.zh:
奥埃诺：听上去很可行！你和你的导师能不能去调查一下？如果采矿点2b

适合这种当地物种生存，我们就把工作地点搬到那里去。

TH_Mine_FindingHearthianLife.en: CYCAD: Site 2b is safe! Coleus says we’ll continue to monitor our activity and its effect on life here.
TH_Mine_FindingHearthianLife.zh:
赛卡德：2b是安全的！科利耶斯说我们会继续监控自己的活

动，

以及该活动对这里的生命所造成的影响。
