TH_Mine_FindingHearthianLife.en: CYCAD: I was watching them once during a rest, and the hours escaped from me. They’re fascinating (I wonder what their fourth eye does)!
TH_Mine_FindingHearthianLife.zh:
赛卡德：有一次休息的时候我观察过它们，一下子就看入迷

了。

它们真是有意思（不知道它们的第四只眼睛是用来干什么的）！

TH_Mine_FindingHearthianLife.en: COLEUS: They remind me of a subterranean species that my mentor, Melorae, once told me about (from when our clan used to travel across this universe). I imagine she would have enjoyed these lifeforms greatly.
TH_Mine_FindingHearthianLife.zh:
科利耶斯：它们让我想起了我的导师梅洛瑞曾经跟我说过的一种地下

物种（当时我们家族经常在这个宇宙里航行）。我想她一定会非常

喜欢这些生命形式。

TH_Mine_SizeOfProject.en: OENO: I’m still amazed by how much ore the Ash Twin Project requires!
TH_Mine_SizeOfProject.zh:
奥埃诺：我还是不敢相信，灰烬双星计划居然需要那么多矿

石！

TH_Mine_SizeOfProject.en: CYCAD: Isn’t this the ore for the remaining towers being built on Ash Twin? The completed towers I’ve seen are quite large!
TH_Mine_SizeOfProject.zh: 赛卡德：这些矿石是要拿去建造灰烬双星上剩余的高塔对吧？我看过那些已经完工的高塔，它们都非常大！

TH_Mine_SizeOfProject.en: OENO: No, the material for those towers is all being taken from Ash Twin. The ore we’re mining here will be used to craft an immensely thick protective shell that will physically seal off the chamber inside Ash Twin’s core.
TH_Mine_SizeOfProject.zh: 奥埃诺：不，那些高塔需要的材料都是从灰烬双星上取得的。我们目前正在开采的矿石会用来制造极厚的保护外壳，以便把舱室封在灰烬双星的核心里。

TH_Mine_SizeOfProject.en: COLEUS: I’m relieved by our clan’s decision to use Timber Hearth’s ore only for constructing the shell. If, eventually, life on this planet were to evolve to the point of advanced metallurgy, I’m confident we won’t have destroyed their ability to create!
TH_Mine_SizeOfProject.zh: 科利耶斯：还好我们的家族决定只使用木炉星的矿石来建造外壳。如果这颗行星上的生命最后演化出了先进的冶金技术，那我们也不会耗尽他们的材料储备！

TH_Mine_SizeOfProject.en: CYCAD: If they're sealing off all entrances, I hope they've planned a-core-dingly!
TH_Mine_SizeOfProject.zh:
赛卡德：如果他们准备密封所有缝隙，希望有对应的核心计

划！

TH_Mine_SizeOfProject.en: OENO: I thought you had forbidden your apprentice from making puns, Coleus.
TH_Mine_SizeOfProject.zh: 奥埃诺：我以为你早就禁止自己的徒弟说谐音段子了呢，科利耶斯。

TH_Mine_SizeOfProject.en: COLEUS: How else would he improve?
TH_Mine_SizeOfProject.zh: 科利耶斯：要不然他怎么会说得这么好呢？

TH_Museum_EyeSymbol.en: CASSAVA: We’re nearly ready! Filix and I have finished construction, and she says calibrating the device won’t take long.
TH_Museum_EyeSymbol.zh:
卡萨瓦：我们就快准备好了！费利克斯和我已经完成了建造，

她说没多久设备就能校准好。

TH_Museum_EyeSymbol.en: FILIX: Fortunately, the Attlerock’s lack of atmosphere will make calibration simple. After all this time, I’m thrilled to finally resume our search!
TH_Museum_EyeSymbol.zh:
费利克斯：好在废岩星的大气稀薄，简化了校准工作。过去了这么久，

我们终于可以重新搜索了。我真是激动万分！

TT_TimeLoop_CoreRemovalWarning.en: Caution: You are about to access the core while the Ash Twin Project is active.
TT_TimeLoop_CoreRemovalWarning.zh: 注意：你即将在灰烬双星计划启动的状态下进入核心。

TT_TimeLoop_CoreRemovalWarning.en: WARNING: Removing the core will disable the Ash Twin Project.
TT_TimeLoop_CoreRemovalWarning.zh: 警告：移除核心将会关闭灰烬双星计划。

TT_TimeLoop_MaskActivationStatus.en: <TimeMinutes> MINUTES, <TimeSeconds> SECONDS AGO: Received data from previous cycles.
TT_TimeLoop_MaskActivationStatus.zh: <TimeMinutes>分钟<TimeSeconds>秒之前：接收到来自之前循环的数据。

TT_TimeLoop_MaskActivationStatus.en:
MASKS RECEIVING DATA FROM:

Probe Tracking Module

Giant's Deep memory statue

Timber Hearth memory statue
TT_TimeLoop_MaskActivationStatus.zh:
面具正在接收以下方面的数据：

探测器跟踪模块

深巨星回忆雕像

木炉星回忆雕像
距离循环结束传输前还有<TimeMinutesRemaining>分钟

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_1.en: YARROW: Today we finished the excavation of Ash Twin. Here, in this space we carved, we will craft our most ambitious project yet: the Ash Twin Project, powerful enough to send information back in time.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_1.zh:
亚罗：今天，我们完成了灰烬双星的挖掘工作。在我们开凿的

这个洞穴里，我们将会打造迄今为止最为雄心勃勃的计划：

灰烬双星计划。它威力强大，足以把信息发送到过去。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_1.en: COLEUS: We’ve also finished relocating all subterranean plants we met while digging.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_1.zh: 科利耶斯：此外，我们在挖掘时发现的所有地下植物也完成了转移。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_1.en: RAMIE: We’ll need to keep our eyes on how significantly we’ve altered the environment here.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_1.zh: 瑞米：我们需要密切注意自己对这里的环境都造成了怎样的显著影响。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_1.en: PYE: How far we’ve come since our experiments at the High Energy Lab! I still can hardly believe Ramie’s hypothesis was true.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_1.zh:
派伊：和当初在高能实验室里的试验相比，我们获得了多么长远的

进步！我依然不敢相信瑞米的假设居然是正确的。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_2.en: YARROW: Poke just sent the warp core for the final tower to us from the Black Hole Forge. Now Ash Twin can be connected with Giant’s Deep, where Cassava is working with Avens to craft the Orbital Probe Cannon, and where Phlox is sculpting the memory statues.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_2.zh:
亚罗：珀克刚刚从黑洞熔炉为我们送来了最后一座高塔的跃迁核心。

现在灰烬双星可以和深巨星建立联系了。卡萨瓦在那里和埃文斯

一起制造轨道探测炮，而弗拉克斯则在雕刻回忆雕

像。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_2.en: CASSAVA: Hypothesis: It was not by accident the core of our warp tower was the last to be forged.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_2.zh:
卡萨瓦：假设：我们的跃迁塔核心是最后一个造出来的，

这并非出于偶然。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_2.en: POKE: Hypothesis: The cores could have been forged faster if Cassava had interrupted my work less frequently to ask for updates.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_2.zh:
珀克：假设：要是卡萨瓦别老是打扰我的工作，询问最新的进展，

核心的锻造速度会更快。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_2.en: YARROW: The important point is we are all connected through Ash Twin now, and also that I’m no longer needed for mediating your disagreements.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_2.zh:
亚罗：重要的是，现在我们都和灰烬双星建立了联系，

而且我再也用不着去调解你们的争执了。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_3a.en: YARROW: Our friends on Giant’s Deep tested the Orbital Probe Cannon today. Mallow tells me the cannon is doing well, and that Avens advocates for more launch power. If anyone can coax the maximum power from a device, Avens can.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_3a.zh:
亚罗：今天，我们在深巨星上的朋友们测试了轨道探测炮。

玛罗告诉我大炮的表现很出色，埃文斯主张加大发射功率。要是有谁

能够把设备的最大功率给发挥出来，那就非埃文斯莫属。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_3a.en: YARROW: But then, if anyone can goad a device into exploding, that, too, is likely Avens. Perhaps I should check in with the Orbital Probe Cannon crew in the interest of safety.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_3a.zh:
亚罗：不过话说回来，把设备弄爆炸的人，多半，也是埃文

斯。

也许出于安全起见，我应该去和轨道探测炮的乘员们确认一下。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_3a.en: YARROW: Would it help to remind Avens that Mallow (his love) will be one of the Nomai aboard the cannon, or is Mallow part of the problem?
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_3a.zh:
亚罗：如果提醒埃文斯，（他的爱人）玛罗也会和其他挪麦人一起乘坐

大炮，情况会不会好一点？还是说玛罗也是造成问题的因素之一？

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_3b.en: YARROW: Phlox and Daz finished the memory statues today, and they are truly remarkable.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_3b.zh: 亚罗：弗拉克斯和戴兹今天完成了回忆雕像。它们真是壮观。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_3b.en: YARROW: When the Ash Twin Project succeeds (or in the event it fails), the memory statues will activate, allowing us to gather more data before we shut down the project.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_3b.zh:
亚罗：一旦灰烬双星计划成功（或者失败的时候），

回忆雕像就会启动，让我们能够在计划关闭之前进一步收集数据。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_3c.en: YARROW: Pye and Idaea have worked hard on the Sun Station, and it at last is complete. If everything goes as planned, this structure will prompt the sun’s explosion, which will in turn supply the power the Ash Twin Project requires.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_3c.zh:
亚罗：经过派伊和伊代亚的努力工作，太阳站终于完工了。

如果一切按照计划进行，这座设施将会刺激太阳爆发，

从而为灰烬双星计划提供所需的动力。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_3c.en: RAMIE: I’m impressed by their mental fortitude. This was the project’s most difficult task, in more ways than one.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_3c.zh:
瑞米：我实在是佩服他们的毅力。从各方面来讲，

这都是计划里最艰难一个的任务。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_4.en: YARROW: We’re nearly ready to activate the Ash Twin Project! Here is what will happen: First, the Sun Station will receive the order to fire at the sun, prompting it to explode.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_4.zh:
亚罗：我们马上就可以启动灰烬双星计划了！接下来会出现这样的

情况：首先，太阳站会收到指令，对太阳进行发射，促使它爆发。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_4.en: YARROW: Using the energy from the resulting supernova, the Ash Twin Project will send the order for the Orbital Probe Cannon to fire back in time by 22 minutes.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_4.zh:
亚罗：借助超新星爆发所产生的能量，灰烬双星计划会向

轨道探测炮下达指令，向过去22分钟进行发射。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_4.en: YARROW: Exactly 22 minutes after these orders are received, the Sun Station will again trigger the supernova to send the probe data from this cannon launch back in time.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_4.zh:
亚罗：收到这些指令22分钟后，太阳站会再次触发超新星，

把这门大炮的探测数据发往过去。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_4.en: YARROW: In total, each cycle created by the Ash Twin Project will last precisely 22 minutes. We can end this cycle at will.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_4.zh:
亚罗：总的来说，灰烬双星计划所产生的每个循环都会

持续22分钟整。我们可以随时中止这一循环。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_5.en: YARROW: These words are difficult to write: The Sun Station did not work.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_5.zh: 亚罗：下面的话实在是叫人痛心：太阳站没能起作用。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_5.en: YARROW: However, this is the closest we have ever been. The Ash Twin Project is theoretically sound; we were only unable to power it. Perhaps there is another way.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_5.zh:
亚罗：然而，这是我们距离成功最近的一次。灰烬双星计划在理论上

是可行的；我们只是无法提供足够的动力。也许还有别的办法。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_5.en: PYE: Suppose we redesign the Sun Station. To generate power of that magnitude, a supernova is still our only viable option.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_5.zh:
派伊：估计我们可以重新设计太阳站。要生成那种级别的动

力，

超新星依然是唯一可行的办法。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_5.en: IDAEA: This is easier expressed than accomplished.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_5.zh: 伊代亚：说起来容易做起来难。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_5.en: PYE: You can wait for the sun to explode on its natural timeline if you prefer, Idaea, but you’ll need to find some way to halt our aging process.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_5.zh:
派伊：如果你愿意的话，你可以等太阳自行爆发的那一天，

伊代亚，不过你得想办法让我们不变老才行。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_5.en: RAMIE: I believe we can still find a way to create a supernova, my friend. Don’t lose hope!
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_5.zh:
瑞米：我相信我们依然能够找到方法来制造一颗超新星，

我的朋友。不要灰心！

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_7.en: YARROW: We are halting our research into creating a supernova for this moment; a comet has newly arrived in this solar system, and we’re anxious to explore it.
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_7.zh:
亚罗：我们目前搁置了制造超新星的研究；一颗彗星最近来到了这个

太阳系，我们急切地想要对它进行探索。

TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_7.en: YARROW: It’s been a very long time since we last explored somewhere new, so we’re excited to welcome this comet. Imagine what knowledge might be gained there!
TT_TimeLoop_Timeline_7.zh:
亚罗：我们已经很久没有探索新的地方了，因此这颗彗星的到来

让我们求之不得。想想看，我们在那里能够获得怎样的知

识！

TT_Tower_BH_1.en: CLARY: Here’s our first delivery, Yarrow: one warp core, fresh from the Black Hole Forge! Root is installing this core’s sibling on Brittle Hollow as I write this.
TT_Tower_BH_1.zh:
克莱瑞：这是我们的首批交付内容，亚罗：黑洞熔炉新鲜出炉的

一颗跃迁核心！此时此刻，鲁特正在碎空星上安装它的兄

弟。

TT_Tower_BH_1.en: CLARY: I wish I could wait here for you to arrive, but the forge (and my unfinished work there) is calling. I’ll return with more materials soon.
TT_Tower_BH_1.zh:
克莱瑞：真希望我能够待在这里等你到来，可是熔炉（以及我在那里

还没有完成的工作）需要我。我很快就会带着更多材料回来的。

TT_Tower_BH_1.en: YARROW: My gratitude, Clary! With this, the Ash Twin Project is underway!
TT_Tower_BH_1.zh: 亚罗：感激不尽，克莱瑞！有了它，灰烬双星计划就可以进行下去了！

TT_Tower_BH_1.en: YARROW: I confess, I’m deeply curious about what you and Poke found on the White Hole Station that started this project. Could I visit sometime to learn more?
TT_Tower_BH_1.zh:
亚罗：你和珀克在白洞站上的发现催生了这个计划。我坦白，

我对这一发现感到十分地好奇。我什么时候能去你们那儿参观一下，

好进一步地了解了解？

TT_Tower_BH_1.en: CLARY: I recommend you do! The White Hole Station is the model for the towers being built for the Ash Twin Project, so a visit to the station would be doubly useful.
TT_Tower_BH_1.zh:
克莱瑞：我建议你一定要来！目前正在为灰烬双星计划建造的高塔

就是以白洞站为模型的。如果你能够来看一看，一定会大有帮助。

TT_Tower_BH_1.en: YARROW: I suppose, more precisely, I would like to visit the White Hole Station with you, Clary.
TT_Tower_BH_1.zh:
亚罗：我估计，更确切地说，我想要和你一起参观白洞站，

克莱瑞。

TT_Tower_BH_1.en: CLARY: I’d be happy to explain our findings!
TT_Tower_BH_1.zh: 克莱瑞：我很乐意为你解说我们发现的内容！

TT_Tower_BH_1.en: POKE: Yarrow, stop using this scroll wall to flirt with my sister (in romantic matters, her density rivals a neutron star’s) and go meet her on the White Hole Station.
TT_Tower_BH_1.zh:
珀克：亚罗，别再用这面卷轴墙和我的姐姐调情了（在感情方面，

她比中子星还要笨拙），快来白洞站找她吧。

TT_Tower_CT.en: PYE: Friends visiting from the Hanging City, we are planning the Ash Twin Project at the High Energy Lab on Ember Twin’s equator.
TT_Tower_CT.zh:
派伊：从悬空城前来拜访的朋友们，我们正在余烬双星赤道的

高能实验室筹备灰烬双星计划。

TT_Tower_CT.en: CONOY: I became lost on Ember Twin (my gratitude that Ramie found me!), but the High Energy Lab is the building with the large solar panels. I’m surprised I didn’t see it!
TT_Tower_CT.zh:
科诺伊：我在余烬双星上迷路了（多亏瑞米找到了我！），

然而高能实验室可是一座拥有许多大型太阳能电池板的建筑。

我居然没有看到！

TT_Tower_CT.en: RAMIE: I imagine our otherwise immensely clever Conoy would lose his own head if it weren’t anatomically impossible!
TT_Tower_CT.zh:
瑞米：要不是这个可能性在解剖学上不成立，不然我还以为我们

聪明异常的科诺伊把自己的脑子给弄丢了呢！

TT_Tower_SS_1.en: YARROW: Some time has passed since I checked in with you, Pye. How are you and Idaea progressing with the Sun Station plans?
TT_Tower_SS_1.zh:
亚罗：派伊，距上次我跟你汇报已经过一阵子了。

你和伊代亚的太阳站计划进行得如何？

TT_Tower_SS_1.en: PYE: Presently, my assessment is that our plan will either fail explosively or succeed explosively.
TT_Tower_SS_1.zh:
派伊：当前我的评估是我们的计划不是一败涂地就是一鸣惊

人。

TT_Tower_SS_1.en: IDAEA: Pye, you know I don’t find that funny.
TT_Tower_SS_1.zh: 伊代亚：派伊，你知道这个笑话不好笑。

TT_Tower_SS_1.en: PYE: How curious; Ramie thinks I’m a gas. And I don’t recall requesting that you monitor this conversation, Idaea.
TT_Tower_SS_1.zh:
派伊：真是奇怪；瑞米竟然觉得我真有意思。

伊代亚，我不记得曾要求你要监控这段对话。

TT_Tower_SS_1.en: IDAEA: I don’t see what state of matter you are has to do with this. And I don’t recall supporting the Sun Station’s construction, but here we are.
TT_Tower_SS_1.zh:
伊代亚：我看不出你跟这事有什么关联。我不记得曾支持

太阳站建设的事，但我们还是到达了太阳站。

TT_Tower_SS_1.en: YARROW: Hypothesis: Time spent away from the station would be beneficial to you both.
TT_Tower_SS_1.zh: 亚罗：假设：远离太阳站所花费的时间对你们俩是件好事。

TT_Tower_SS_1.en: PYE: I’m immensely interested in testing your hypothesis, Yarrow.
TT_Tower_SS_1.zh: 派伊：亚罗，我对验证你的假设非常有兴趣。

TT_Tower_SS_1.en: IDAEA: That, at least, we can agree on.
TT_Tower_SS_1.zh: 伊代亚：至少这件事我们同调。

WH_TimeDelay_1.en: CLARY: To our friends on Brittle Hollow: I just warped here from the White Hole Station (on the other side of Brittle Hollow’s black hole)! Our design worked; we’ve successfully recreated warp travel!
WH_TimeDelay_1.zh:
克莱瑞：给我们在碎空星上的朋友们：

我刚刚从白洞站（碎空星黑洞的另一头）跃迁到了这里！

我们的设计方案起作用了；我们成功地再现了跃迁旅行！

WH_TimeDelay_1.en: FILIX: This is wonderful news! I can’t wait to see the warp tower (although it’s been a long time since I’ve jumped through a black hole!).
WH_TimeDelay_1.zh:
费利克斯：这真是天大的好消息！我迫不及待地想要看看跃迁塔

的样子（虽然我上次穿越黑洞已经是很久以前的事情

了！）。

WH_TimeDelay_1.en: POKE: I don’t know how close it is to Annona’s original design, but as long as what we’ve built works, then I’m delighted! I knew we could do it (Cassava, I hope you’re reading this)!
WH_TimeDelay_1.zh:
珀克：我不知道它和安诺纳的原版设计有多大的差别，不过只要能管用，

那我就很高兴！我就知道我们能成功（卡萨瓦，但愿你正在看）！

WH_TimeDelay_1.en: POKE: Wait, this can’t be correct. Clary, have you seen these readings? If they were accurate, they would violate causality. There must be an equipment error somewhere.
WH_TimeDelay_1.zh:
珀克：等等，这不可能。克莱瑞，你看到这些读数了吗？如果读数正确，

那么它们就违反了因果律。一定是有什么地方的设备出现了问题。

WH_TimeDelay_1.en: POKE: I’m returning to the White Hole Station. If you and Root meet me there, we can run a full diagnostic and hopefully locate the problem.
WH_TimeDelay_1.zh:
珀克：我正在返回白洞站。如果你和鲁特去那里找我，

我们可以进行一次全面诊断，希望能够把问题给找出来。

WH_TimeDelay_2.en: PYE: Ramie and I reviewed the records you sent, Poke, and they appear to show Nomai are arriving at the warp receiver on Brittle Hollow slightly before departing from the White Hole Station.
WH_TimeDelay_2.zh:
派伊：瑞米和我查看了你送来的记录，珀克，貌似挪麦人抵达碎空星

跃迁接收点的时间比离开白洞站的时间要稍微早那么一点点。

WH_TimeDelay_2.en: POKE: I understand it’s exceedingly odd, but Clary and I have tested and retested the equipment, and the result is the same every time someone warps.
WH_TimeDelay_2.zh:
珀克：我明白这一现象极为奇怪，但是克莱瑞和我已经一次次地对设备

进行过了测试，每一次的跃迁结果都是一样的。

WH_TimeDelay_2.en: RAMIE: The interval is incredibly minuscule (roughly one hundred-thousandth of a second). Do you suppose our instruments can’t accurately measure time to such a small degree?
WH_TimeDelay_2.zh:
瑞米：其时间间隔异常微小（大约只有十万分之一秒）。

你是否认为我们的仪器无法精确测量尺度如此微观的时间量？

WH_TimeDelay_2.en: PYE: As I’ve already told Ramie, these measurements can’t be accurate. How can a Nomai arrive on Brittle Hollow before he or she ever stepped into the teleporter? The implications are absurd.
WH_TimeDelay_2.zh:
派伊：就像我对瑞米说过得那样，这些测量结果不可能精确。

挪麦人怎么可能在踏上传送器之前，就已经抵达碎空星了呢？

这其中的逻辑关系太荒谬了。

WH_TimeDelay_2.en: POKE: I don’t disagree. It would mean I’ve inadvertently broken several fundamental theories regarding this universe. We would have to reconsider all of our beliefs about the nature of time.
WH_TimeDelay_2.zh:
珀克：我不同意。这可能意味着我不小心打破了这个宇宙的几个

基本理论。我们应该重新考虑一下我们所有与时间本质有关的认知。

WH_TimeDelay_2.en: RAMIE: Yes, I hope so, too!
WH_TimeDelay_2.zh: 瑞米：没错，我也是这么认为的！

WH_TimeDelay_2.en: RAMIE: Poke, as Pye is confident the reading is inaccurate, she’s kindly helping me attempt to recreate this phenomenon at the High Energy Lab. We’re designing an experiment to take more data.
WH_TimeDelay_2.zh:
瑞米：珀克，派伊坚信读数不准确，她好心要帮我在高能实验室

试着再现这一现象。我们正在设计一次实验，来获取更多数据。

WH_TimeDelay_2.en: PYE: An update: Poke, the High Energy Lab is in the canyon on Ember Twin’s equator. Come here at once. You need to see this.
WH_TimeDelay_2.zh:
派伊：更新：珀克，高能实验室位于余烬双星

赤道的峡谷里。立刻过来。你得瞧瞧这个。

WH_WarpTowerInstructions.en: POKE: Welcome to the White Hole Station! If you fell through the black hole by accident (don't worry, you aren’t the first), this warp tower can return you to Brittle Hollow.
WH_WarpTowerInstructions.zh:
珀克：欢迎来到白洞站！如果你不小心掉进黑洞

（别担心，你不是第一个），这座跃迁塔可以把你带回碎空星。

WH_WarpTowerInstructions.en: POKE: Every warp tower is tuned to a specific astral body. A tower's warp can only be used during the brief window when the tower is aligned with its corresponding astral body (in this case, Brittle Hollow).
WH_WarpTowerInstructions.zh: 珀克：每座挪麦跃迁塔都与某一特定天体匹配。珀克：每座跃迁塔都与某一特定天体匹配。只有在对准对应天体的短暂时间内，跃迁塔才能执行跃迁（这座塔对应的是碎空星）。

WH_WarpTowerInstructions.en: You must be standing on the warp platform on the floor during this alignment to be warped.
WH_WarpTowerInstructions.zh: 要进行跃迁，你必须在对准时站在地上的跃迁平台上。

WH_WarpTowerInstructions.en: POKE: If you look up while the station is rotating, you can see the alignment happens when the astral body is directly overhead.
WH_WarpTowerInstructions.zh: 珀克：如果在白洞站旋转时向上看，你可以看到对准的过程，那时天体会在你的正上方。

relationship_coverage.decision: 安诺纳询问伯尔能否找到其他逃生舱信号；两人也接续讨论量子卫星的位置。
克莱瑞说明安诺纳设计了原核心、珀克曾是其学徒；这条文本不能单独证明克莱瑞也受过安诺纳教导。
安诺纳参与组织寻找失踪的科利耶斯；科利耶斯后来提到与安诺纳等人建造量子卫星定位器。
艾斯科尔向安诺纳确认飞船能否跃迁至信号所在位置。
费利克斯明确说自己与安诺纳在跃迁前检查过核心和导航系统。
拉米在发现节报告中以安诺纳的跃迁核心为例；没有记载二人直接见面。
梅洛瑞和安诺纳交流量子卫星观察，并共同寻找科利耶斯；安诺纳称梅洛瑞为朋友。
导师 → 徒弟
鲁斯向安诺纳报告2号舱乘客受惊但身体无恙，均在撞击中幸存。
戴兹与卡萨瓦是配偶，埃文斯是戴兹的兄弟，因此卡萨瓦与埃文斯有姻亲关系；二人也直接合作并相称朋友。不指定兄弟长幼。
不推断长幼。
伊代亚强调重建核心较安全，埃文斯追问最安全的选择是否就是最好的选择；不把一次讨论写成永久敌对。
配偶
普利维特报告两台定位器都无法捕捉眼信号，埃文斯提出眼可能停止发信；另有二人在轨道炮团队中的记录。
亚罗记述埃文斯参与轨道炮、偏爱更大功率，并担忧安全；部分信息来自玛罗，不据此声称全部是两人直接对话。
不自动等于明确的正式师徒。
接应会合
克莱姆接着布洛密的话回忆艾斯科尔失踪的故事。
布洛密回忆祖父讲过的艾斯科尔失踪传说；这不是两人的同时代交往。
澄清失踪历史
伯尔从背阴城赶来协助寻找科利耶斯，并询问其失踪前的情况。
伯尔帮助梅洛瑞寻找科利耶斯，两人讨论量子卫星与第六地点的可能性。
关切／会合
卡萨瓦承认克莱瑞让自己与珀克成为更好的团队，并想先向克莱瑞道歉。
卡萨瓦向科诺伊请教部件下沉现象，科诺伊邀请其看模型并讲解；二人也讨论视觉探测方案的困难与时间技术。
亲爱的称呼、配偶与共同留守安排相互印证。
卡萨瓦明确说与费利克斯完成了定位器建造，费利克斯负责校准；后来讨论寻找更灵敏设备。
卡萨瓦回应玛罗的视觉探测提议，指出随机发射方向的困难；停工时请玛罗返回建造厂。
